title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia's upcoming constitutional reforms and the shift toward demographic majoritarianism within the Prosperity Party are significantly altering the traditional influence of Amhara politics. Historically, Amhara political identity was deeply connected to the state's center, but it is now increasingly being marginalized as power shifts toward numerical representation based on population size. This transition marks a departure from the previous coalition model, forcing the Amhara political establishment to confront a new reality where their traditional dominance is no longer guaranteed.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ እየተካሄዱ ያሉት ሕገ-መንግሥታዊ ማሻሻያዎች እና ብልጽግና ፓርቲ የሚከተለው በቁጥር ላይ የተመሠረተ የውክልና አሠራር የአማራን የፖለቲካ ተፅእኖ እየለወጡት ይገኛል። በአንጻራዊ ሁኔታ አማራዎች የኢትዮጵያን የመንግሥት ማዕከል በቅርበት ሲቆጣጠሩ የቆዩ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን ያለው የፖለቲካ አሰላለፍ ወደ ቁጥር ተኮር ሥርዓት በመሸጋገሩ የፖለቲካ ተፅእኖአቸው እየተዳከመ መጥቷል። ይህ ለውጥ የቀድሞውን የጥምር ፓርቲ ሥርዓት በማስቀረት፣ የአማራ የፖለቲካ ኃይሎች በሕዝብ ብዛት ላይ በተመሠረተ አዲስ የፖለቲካ እውነታ ውስጥ መፈተናቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hojiin jijjiirama heera mootummaa Itoophiyaa fi imaammanni paartii Badhaadhinaa lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa'e, dhiibbaa siyaasaa kan Amaaraa kanaan dura ture jijjiiraa jira. Akkuma kanaan dura, siyaasni Amaaraa giddugala mootummaa Itoophiyaa wajjin walitti hidhata cimaa kan qabu ture, garuu amma sirna lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa'e kanaan gara alatti dhiibamaa jira. Jijjiiramni kun sirna kanaan dura ture kan diiguu fi siyaasni Amaaraa humna lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa'e kana wajjin akka wal qabatu dirqisiisaa jira.

title: Dozens killed in rebel attacks on Sudan’s Kordofan, medical group says
english: A medical group reports that 27 people, including four children, were killed in attacks by the SPLM-N rebel group in Sudan’s South Kordofan province. The violence targeted the local Otoro tribe, forcing many residents to flee their homes and raising concerns about a potential ethnic conflict. Humanitarian organizations are now calling for international intervention to stop these attacks and protect civilians amid the broader Sudanese civil war.
amharic: የሱዳን የህክምና ባለሙያዎች አውታረ መረብ በሱዳን ደቡብ ኮርዶፋን ግዛት በታጣቂዎች በተፈፀመ ጥቃት አራት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ 27 ሰዎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ በተለይ በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ የኦቶሮ ጎሳ አባላት ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ ብዙ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ምክንያት ሆኗል። የህክምና ቡድኑ ይህ ድርጊት በዘር ላይ ያነጣጠረ ግጭት እንዳይባባስ ስጋት የፈጠረ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ በሲቪሎች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት ለማስቆም ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ጠይቋል።
oromo: Garee ogeeyyii fayyaa Sudaan akka gabaasetti, gareen finxaaleyyii SPLM-N jedhamu naannoo Kordofaan Kibbaatti namoota 27, kanneen keessaa ijoollee afur, ajjeesaniiru. Haleellaan kun sanyii Otoro irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, uummanni hedduunis qe'ee isaanii dhiisanii baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Gareen fayyaa kun gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa sanyii hammaachuu danda'u waan sodaachisuuf, hawaasni idil-addunyaa miidhaa sivilii irra ga'u dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafateera.

title: Instagram chief testifies at Meta trial, says few teens used safety feature
english: The head of Instagram, Adam Mosseri, testified in a major legal case against Meta, admitting that very few teenagers utilized the app's 'Take a Break' feature before it became mandatory. Meta is currently facing lawsuits from 29 U.S. states alleging that the company deliberately designed its platforms to be addictive and harmful to the mental health of young users. While the company denies these claims, it faces billions in potential damages for its practices involving data collection and child safety.
amharic: የኢንስታግራም ዋና ስራ አስኪያጅ አዳም ሞሴሪ በሜታ ኩባንያ ላይ በተመሰረተው ክስ ምስክርነታቸውን የሰጡ ሲሆን፣ አፕሊኬሽኑ 'እረፍት ይውሰዱ' የተሰኘውን የደህንነት መጠበቂያ አገልግሎት አስገዳጅ ከመሆኑ በፊት ጥቂት ታዳጊዎች ብቻ ይጠቀሙበት እንደነበር አምነዋል። ሜታ መድረኮቹን ሆን ብሎ ለታዳጊዎች ሱስ የሚያስይዙ እና ለጤና ጎጂ አድርጎ በመቅረጹ በ29 የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች ክስ ቀርቦበታል። ኩባንያው ክሱን ቢክድም፣ ህገ-ወጥ የመረጃ አሰባሰብ እና በታዳጊዎች ደህንነት ላይ ባደረሰው ጉዳት የቢሊዮን ዶላር ካሳ ሊጠየቅ ይችላል።
oromo: Hogganaan Instagram, Adam Mosseri, himata Meta irratti dhiyaate irratti dhugaa ba'aniiru. Akka isaan jedhanitti, 'Take a Break' ykn 'Boqannaa fudhadhu' kan jedhu meeshaan fayyadamtootaaf ofumaan akka hojjetu osoo hin godhin dura, ijoolleen muraasni qofa fayyadamaa turan. Meta irratti himanni kan dhiyaate, qindaa'ina fayyadamtoota isaa keessatti ijoollee fi dargaggoota adda durummaan akka itti hammadhan gochuu fi fayyaa isaanii irratti miidhaa geessisuu isaatiin walqabatee dha. Komii kana Meta kan haalu yoo ta'u, himannoon kun biyyoota 29 keessatti dhiyaatee fi kaffaltii miiliyoonaan lakkaa'amu gaafachuu isaatiin mata-duree guddina argate dha.

title: Who were the Syrian Democratic Forces and why dissolve?
english: The Syrian Democratic Forces, a coalition that played a major role in the battle against ISIL, have announced they are disbanding. This decision follows an agreement with the Syrian interim government to fold various militia groups into the national army. The move aims to consolidate military power under the country's official armed forces.
amharic: በአይኤስአይኤል ላይ በተደረገው ውጊያ ግንባር ቀደም ሚና የነበራቸው የሶሪያ ዴሞክራቲክ ኃይሎች መፍረሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ከተለያዩ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ጋር በመስማማት እነርሱን በሀገሪቱ ኦፊሴላዊ የጦር ኃይል ውስጥ ለማካተት ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ወታደራዊ ኃይልን በሀገሪቱ መደበኛ የጦር ሠራዊት ስር ለማሰባሰብ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Dimookiraatawaa Siiriyaa, kan ISIL irratti lolarratti hirmaachaa turan, akka diigaman beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan fudhatame mootummaa yeroo Siiriyaa waliin walii galtee uumuun gareewwan hidhattootaa gara raayyaa ittisa biyyattiitti makufi. Tarkaanfiin kun humnoota waraanaa biyyattii jala tokko gochuufi.

title: Bangladesh could join Mecca pact, official suggests
english: Bangladesh is considering joining a new security pact involving Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan. This agreement functions similarly to NATO by treating an attack on one member as an assault on the entire group. Officials in Dhaka have responded positively to the invitation, suggesting that the nation is open to participating in this collective military alliance.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመውን አዲስ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት የመቀላቀል እድልን እያጤነች ነው። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ አባል ሀገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደደረሰ የሚቆጠርበት የኔቶ አይነት ወታደራዊ መርህ አለው። የባንግላዲሽ መንግስት ለዚህ ጥሪ አዎንታዊ ምላሽ የሰጠ ሲሆን በስምምነቱ ውስጥ የመሳተፍ ፍላጎት እንዳለው አመላክቷል።
oromo: Bangladeshiin waliigaltee nageenyaa haaraa kan Turkey, Saudi Arabia fi Pakistan gidduutti mallatteeffame waliin makamuuf yaadaa jirti. Waliigalteen kun akka NATO, biyyoota miseensa ta'an keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, kanneen biroos akka haleelamanii fudhatamu ibsa. Mootummaan Bangladesh afeerrii kanaaf deebii gaarii kennee fi waliigaltee kana keessatti hirmaachuuf fedhii akka qabu ibseera.

title: Houthi leader underlines support for Palestinians, slams Saudi 'tyranny'
english: Houthi leader Abdel-Malik al-Houthi has reaffirmed his group's commitment to supporting Palestinian fighters in their conflict against Israel. He also criticized Saudi Arabia, accusing the country of oppressing the Yemeni people through a blockade and military aggression. Consequently, he called for stronger actions to oppose Saudi policies, which he claims are supported by the United States.
amharic: የሁቲው መሪ አብዱል-ማሊክ አል-ሁቲ ለፍልስጤም ታጋዮች ያላቸውን ድጋፍ እንደገና አረጋግጠዋል። በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይም በየመን ህዝብ ላይ ግፍ እና ጭቆና ፈፅመዋል በማለት ጠንካራ ወቀሳ ሰንዝረዋል። የሳውዲ አረቢያ ፖሊሲዎች በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የሚከናወኑ ናቸው ያሉት መሪው፣ እነዚህን ድርጊቶች ለመቃወም አዳዲስ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan garee Huutii Abdel-Maalik al-Huutii, loltoota Falasxiinif deeggarsa qaban kan irra deebi'anii mirkaneessan ta'uu ibsame. Sudaan Arabaa ilaalchisees, ummata Yamanirratti cunqursaa fi gochaa sirrii hin taane raawwachuu isaaniitiin balaaleffataniiru. Gochi kunis deeggarsa Ameerikaatiin kan raawwatamu ta'uu eeruun, siyaasa Sa'udii kana mormuuf tarkaanfiin haaraan akka fudhatamu waamicha dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Israeli soldiers block Knesset member from besieged Palestinian home
english: Israeli military personnel prevented Knesset member Ofer Cassif from visiting a Palestinian family in the West Bank village of Qusra. The family has been under a blockade by Israeli settlers for over two weeks. Despite the initial obstruction by the soldiers, the politician eventually succeeded in reaching the residents to offer his solidarity.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የፓርላማ አባል የሆኑትን ኦፈር ካሲፍ በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰብን እንዳይጎበኙ ከልክለዋቸዋል። ቤተሰቡ ለ17 ቀናት በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ተከበው እንደነበር ተገልጿል። በመጨረሻም የፓርላማ አባሉ ወታደሮቹ ቢከለክሏቸውም ወደ ቤተሰቡ በመድረስ ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el miseensa Mana Maree (Knesset) Ofer Cassif jedhaman, maatii Palastaayinii magaalaa Qusraa, kan Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessa jiraatan akka hin daawwanne dhowwate. Maatiin kun guyyoota 17f qe'ee isaanii keessatti qarqara lixaa kan qubatanii jiran irraa baqachuu hin dandeenye ture. Hanqina waraanni uumeen ala, miseensi kun boodarra maatii sana bira gahuun gadda isaanii qooddachuuf danda'eera.

title: Mamdani opposes Hindu nationalist event in New York
english: New York official Zohran Mamdani has publicly criticized a planned Hindu nationalist event at Madison Square Garden. He expressed concern that the group behind the gathering promotes an exclusionary agenda and maintains ties to India’s ruling political party. Mamdani's opposition highlights tensions regarding the group's ideological influence within the city.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ባለስልጣን ዞህራን ማምዳኒ በሜዲሰን ስኩዌር ጋርደን ሊካሄድ የታቀደውን የሂንዱ ብሄርተኛ ዝግጅት በይፋ ተቃውመዋል። ዝግጅቱን የሚያዘጋጀው ቡድን አድልኦ የተሞላበት አካሄድ እንዳለው እና ከህንድ ገዥ ፓርቲ ጋር ጥብቅ ግንኙነት እንዳለው ገልጸዋል። የማምዳኒ ተቃውሞ ቡድኑ በከተማዋ ሊኖረው ስለሚችለው የርዕዮተ ዓለም ተጽዕኖ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni magaalaa Niyoork Zohran Mamdani, sagantaa biyyaaleessa Hindu kan madison Square Garden keessatti qophaa'uuf karoorfame mormaniiru. Gareen saganticha qopheessu kun ilaalcha namaa gargar qoodu qabaachuu fi paartii biyya Indiyaa bulchaa jiru waliin hidhata cimaa akka qaban ibsaniiru. Mormiin Mamdani, dhiibbaa ideolojiin garee kanaa magaalaatti qabaachuu danda'u irratti yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Water crisis makes life in Sudan’s El Obeid refugee camps even worse
english: Families living in refugee camps in El Obeid, Sudan, are facing a severe humanitarian struggle due to a critical lack of water. This shortage is largely caused by the Rapid Support Forces, who are intentionally attacking the city's essential water infrastructure. As a result, the displaced population is enduring increasingly difficult and dangerous living conditions.
amharic: በሱዳን ኤል ኦቤይድ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች የሚኖሩ ቤተሰቦች በከባድ የውሃ እጥረት እየተሰቃዩ ይገኛል። ይህ ችግር የተፈጠረው የራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሶች የከተማዋን ዋና ዋና የውሃ ምንጮች በማጥቃታቸው ነው። በጦርነቱ የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች በአስቸጋሪ እና በከፋ የኑሮ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንዲያልፉ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Maatiin buufata baqattootaa El Obeid, Sudaan keessa jiraatan hanqina bishaanii cimaan miidhamaniiru. Hanqinni kun kan uumame waraana Rapid Support Forces tiin maddoota bishaan magaala sanatti xiyyeeffatanii haleelaa waan jiraniifi. Bu’aa kanaanis, namoonni sababa waraanaan buqqa’an haala jireenyaa baay’ee ulfaataa fi sodaachisaa ta’e keessa darbanii jiru.

title: Israel expels Dutch representatives from Gaza coordination center
english: Israel has ordered Dutch representatives to leave a Gaza coordination facility and exit the country within a week. This action was taken after the Netherlands moved to prohibit imports coming from Israeli settlements in occupied territories. Israeli officials described this move as a retaliatory measure against what they consider to be hostile policies from the Dutch government.
amharic: ኔዘርላንድስ ከተያዙት የፍልስጤም ግዛቶች የሚመጡ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ምርቶችን እንደምትከለክል ካስታወቀች በኋላ፣ እስራኤል የደች ተወካዮችን ከጋዛ ማስተባበሪያ ማዕከል አባረረች። እስራኤል ተወካዮቹ በአንድ ሳምንት ውስጥ አገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አዘዛለች። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ይህ ውሳኔ የደች መንግስት በእስራኤል ላይ እየወሰዳቸው ባሉ ተከታታይ እርምጃዎች የተወሰደ የበቀል እርምጃ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan ykn mootummaan Israa'el bakka bu'oota biyya Neezerlaand kanneen Gaza keessatti qindoomina irratti hojjetan biyyattii akka gadhiisan ajajtee jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame Neezerlaandi oomishoota buufataalee Israa'el kanneen lafa qabame keessa jiran irraa dhufan akka hin seennesne murteessuun ishee hordofee dha. Mootummaan Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate, gochaalee mootummaan Neezerlaand Israa'el irratti qabate jedhanii kan mormaniif deebii kennuuf akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Malaysia’s Anwar puts non-aligned stance in focus with remarks on Taiwan
english: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim sparked debate after stating that Taiwan is part of China, leading to criticism from the Taiwanese government. While China praised his remarks, Anwar later clarified that he supports a peaceful resolution to the cross-strait conflict. Amid these tensions, the Prime Minister is also seeking to strengthen Malaysia's military defenses near the Philippines, highlighting his effort to balance the country's non-aligned stance.
amharic: የማሌዥያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዋር ኢብራሂም ታይዋን የቻይና አካል ናት በሚል የሰጡት አስተያየት አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ይህ ንግግር በቻይና ዘንድ ምስጋና ቢቸረውም፣ ታይዋን ግን አቋሙን በመተቸት ስጋቷን ገልጻለች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በኋላ ላይ ግጭቶች በሰላማዊ መንገድ እንዲፈቱ እንደሚፈልጉ አስታውቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ ወቅት፣ ከፊሊፒንስ አቅራቢያ የሚገኘውን ወታደራዊ አቅማቸውን ለማጠናከር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ማሌዥያ በቻይና እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያላትን ገለልተኛ አቋም ለመጠበቅ የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Maleeziyaa Anwaar Ibraahim, Taayilaandiin kutaa Chaayinaati jechuun isaanii mormii fi haasaa guddaa uumee jira. Chaayinaan ibsa isaanii kana yoo galateeffattu, mootummaan Taayilaandi garuu yaada isaanii kana balaaleffatee jira. Anwaar yeroo booda rakkoon kun nagaan akka furamu fedha qaban ibsuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Kana malees, Maleeziyaan biyyoota gurguddoo lamaan gidduutti qabxii giddu-galeessummaa qabachuu ishee ibsuuf, daangaa biyyattii irra jiru cimsuuf sochii gochaa jiru.

title: Is Sudan’s battlefield shaping the terms of its next political phase?
english: Sudan’s ongoing civil war is experiencing a potential turning point as the national army secures key supply routes in North Kordofan. The paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are struggling with internal unity, evidenced by a rising number of soldiers and commanders defecting to the military. Meanwhile, General al-Burhan is attempting to leverage these battlefield successes to guide the nation's future political landscape.
amharic: የሱዳን የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት የሀገሪቱ ጦር በሰሜን ኮርዶፋን ስልታዊ የሆኑ የትራንስፖርት መስመሮችን በመቆጣጠሩ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ላይ የደረሰ ይመስላል። የፈጥኖ ደራሽ ኃይሉ (RSF) ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ወታደሮች እና አዛዦች ወደ መንግስት ጦር እየተቀላቀሉ በመሆኑ የውስጥ መከፋፈል ገጥሞታል። በዚህ ሁኔታ ውስጥ የሀገሪቱ የጦር መሪ ጄኔራል አል-ቡርሃን በጦር ሜዳ የተገኙ ውጤቶችን በመጠቀም የፖለቲካ ሂደቱን ለመምራት እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraanni biyya Sudaan keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru jijjiirama barbaachisaa tokko keessa jira; kunis kan ta'e humnoonni waraana mootummaa daandiiwwan dhiyeessii ijoo ta'an naannoo Kordofaan Kaabaatti too'annaa isaanii jala galchuun isaaniiti. Humnoonni Rapid Support Forces (RSF) jedhaman lollatoonniifi ajajoonni isaanii hedduun gara waraana mootummaatti dabalamuu isaaniitiin rakkoo tokkummaa keessoo waliin qabsoo irra jiru. Gammachuu waraana kanaa fayyadamuun, Jeneraal Al-Burhaan adeemsa siyaasaa gara fuulduraa irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaalaa jiru.

title: Human rights situation in Myanmar ‘plummets to new low’, UN says
english: The United Nations reports that the human rights situation in Myanmar has reached a critical low since the 2021 military coup. Ongoing violence, including airstrikes and forced labor, has resulted in thousands of civilian deaths, millions of displaced people, and widespread malnutrition. Additionally, the Rohingya minority continues to face systematic abuse and violence from both the military and local ethnic armed groups.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በምያንማር ያለው የሰብአዊ መብት ሁኔታ ከ2021 ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ወዲህ እጅግ አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። በአየር ጥቃትና በግዴታ ስራ ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች መገደላቸውን፣ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ መፈናቀላቸውን እና የምግብ እጥረት መስፋፋቱን ሪፖርቱ ያሳያል። በተጨማሪም የሮሂንጋ አናሳ ብሄረሰብ በወታደራዊው መንግስት እና በተለያዩ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች በኩል ስልታዊ ጥቃትና በደል እየደረሰባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, haalli mirga namoomaa biyya Miyaanmaar keessatti kanneen bara 2021 erga mootummaan waraanaa aangoo qabatee as hammaatee jira. Waraana, miidhaa qaamaa fi buqqaatiin namoota kumaatamaatti lakkaa’aman ajjeesee, miiliyoonatti kan lakkaa’aman ammoo qe’ee irraa buqqisee akkasumas hanqina nyaataa cimaa fidee jira. Akkaataa kanaan, sanyiin xiqqaan Roohingiyaa lachuu mootummaa waraanaa fi garee hidhattootaa irraa miidhaa fi dararaa hamaa keessa jiru.

title: Israeli troops advance into Syrian village, attack southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces have moved into the village of Jumla within Syria's Daraa region. Simultaneously, the Israeli air force conducted a bombing operation against Kafr Rummana in southern Lebanon. These actions represent a significant escalation of ongoing regional military activity.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሶሪያ ዳራ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኘው የጁምላ መንደር መግባታቸው ተዘግቧል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ፣ የእስራኤል አየር ኃይል በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው ካፍር ሩማና ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የሚያጠናክሩ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Jumlaa kan naannoo Daaraa Sooriyaa keessatti argamu seenaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, xiyyaaronni waraana Israa'el ganda Kafr Ruumaanaa kan kibba Liibaanoos keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Gochootni kun sochii waraana naannichaa kan yeroodhaa gara yerootti jabaataa deemu kan agarsiisanidha.

title: Watch: Analyst says US lacks leverage to force global isolation of Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has introduced a new policy called 'Operation Economic Outcast,' demanding that nations sever all economic ties with Iran. The initiative threatens sanctions against any country that refuses to comply with these US demands. Analysts are questioning whether this strategy will be effective or if it signals a lack of viable diplomatic options for the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት 'ኦፕሬሽን ኢኮኖሚክ አውትካስት' የተሰኘ አዲስ ፖሊሲ ይፋ አድርገዋል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት፣ አገራት ከኢራን ጋር ያላቸውን የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጡ የሚጠይቅ ሲሆን፣ ይህንን ለማያደርጉ አገራት ማዕቀብ እንደሚጣልባቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ተንታኞች ይህ ስልት ውጤታማ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ወይም የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር አማራጭ መፍትሄዎች እንደሌሉት በመጠራጠር ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskoottii Besent, 'Operation Economic Outcast' kan jedhamu duula haaraa biyyoonni Iran waliin hariiroo diinagdee hunda akka kutatan dirqisiisuu jalqabaniiru. Ameerikaan biyyoonni ajaja kana hin fudhanne irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa (sanctions) fudhachuu akka dandeessu akeekkachiisteetti. Hayyoonni hedduun duulli kun bu'aa qabaachuu isaa ykn mootummaan kun furmaata biraa dhabuun isaa shakkiin keessa galaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Iran says Hormuz remains closed despite Oman route deal
english: Iranian officials have declared that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, rejecting claims that a transit agreement with Oman has resolved the issue. While President Trump stated that international waters in the strait have been cleared of mines, Iran insists that the route will stay blocked until the United States fulfills its previous commitments. The U.S. has warned that any future attempts by Iran to deploy mines in the area will be met with immediate military action.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ከኦማን ጋር በተደረገው ስምምነት መሰረት የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ክፍት እንደሆነ የሚነገረውን መረጃ አስተባብለዋል። የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ፈንጂዎች መጸዳታቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ ኢራን አሜሪካ የተገባላትን ቃል እስካልጠበቀች ድረስ የባህር መስመሩ ዝግ እንደሚሆን አስታውቃለች። አሜሪካ በበኩሏ ኢራን እንደገና ፈንጂዎችን ብትጥል ተመጣጣኝ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran akka jedhanitti, walii galtee Omaan waliin godhamee jiruun ala balballi galaana Hormuz kan cufame dha. Preezidaant Traampii fiixee bishaanota idil-addunyaa keessatti minoonni hundi qulqulleeffamaniiru jedhanii himanis, Iran hanga Ameerikaan waadaa ishee eegutti karaichi cufaa akka ta'e dubbatti. Ameerikaan gama isheetiin, Iran yoo gara fuulduraatti minoota kaahuu yaalte tarkaanfiin waraanaa irratti fudhatamuuf akka jiru akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Yemeni forces claim killing of eight Houthi fighters
english: Yemeni government forces successfully defended their positions after a Houthi attack in the southwestern province of Taiz. During the intense battle, which involved significant gunfire, at least eight Houthi fighters were killed. The military confirmed that the fighting took place in the al-Safa region.

title: Brazil fines TikTok $30m for child data privacy violations
english: Brazil has fined TikTok's parent company, ByteDance, nearly $30 million for mishandling the personal information of millions of young users. Regulators found that the platform's age-verification systems were flawed, allowing children to access the app without proper safeguards. The company has been ordered to delete the illegally collected data and develop a better plan to protect minors.

title: Why can’t America agree on what time it is?
english: The United States is currently debating whether to stop the practice of changing clocks twice a year. title: US judge blocks Ohio law requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote
english: A federal judge in Ohio has temporarily stopped a new state law that demanded proof of citizenship for voter registration during driver's license applications. This decision prevents the state from requiring such proof, asserting that a signed declaration of citizenship is sufficient for registration.

english: Country music icon Dolly Parton has passed away in Nashville, Tennessee, at the age of 80. Her family and representatives confirmed the news of her death. Parton was widely celebrated as the legendary Queen of Country for her immense contributions to the music industry.
