oromo: Weerartuu muuziqaa biyyaa kan taate Dolii Paarten waggaa 80tti magaalaa Naashivili, Teneesii keessatti du'uun ishee ibsameera. Du'a ishee ilaalchisee maatiin ishee fi bakka bu'oonni ishee mirkaneessaniiru. Paarten muuziqaa biyyaa keessatti gumaacha guddaa gooteef 'Nageettii Muuziqaa Biyyaa' jedhamtee beekamti.

title: Seven killed in Gaza as Israeli strike ‘destroys’ aid supply warehouse
english: Israeli military strikes across Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least seven Palestinians despite an existing ceasefire. Among the attacks, a critical warehouse storing nutritional aid for women and children was destroyed, ruining essential supplies. Health officials have warned that these ongoing strikes are pushing the region toward a total collapse of basic life-sustaining services.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው የእስራኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ጥቃቱ ለሴቶችና ለህጻናት የሚውሉ የምግብ ዕርዳታዎችን የሚያከማች መጋዘን ሙሉ በሙሉ በማውደሙ በሰብአዊ አቅርቦቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። የጤና ባለስልጣናት ቀጣይነት ያለው ጥቃት በጋዛ የነዋሪዎችን መሠረታዊ ህልውና አደጋ ላይ እንደጣለው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el iddoowwan garaa garaa Gazaaratti dhukaasa baneen namoota Falasxiinii torba ta'an ajjeeseera. Dhukaasa kanaanis mana kuusa gargaarsa nyaataa kan dubartootaa fi daa'immanii miidhuu danda'u guutummaatti barbadeesseera. Hoggantoonni fayyaa akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun rakkoo jireenyaa bu'uuraa kan guutummaatti laafisuu fi balaa guddaa keessa galchuudha.

title: Iran's Ghalibaf tells Iraqi official 'new regional order' being created
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf recently informed Iraq's chief justice that a new regional order is emerging in the Middle East. He praised the upcoming withdrawal of American forces from Iraq as a significant achievement for the country. Ghalibaf also claimed that Iran has successfully resisted U.S. political and military influence, predicting that American efforts to pressure the region will ultimately fail.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ከኢራቅ ዋና ዳኛ ጋር ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ አዲስ የክልል ስርአት እየተፈጠረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ከኢራቅ መውጣታቸውን ለኢራቅ ህዝብ ትልቅ ታሪካዊ ክብር እንደሆነ አወድሰዋል። በተጨማሪም ኢራን በአሜሪካ ላይ ወታደራዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ድል መቀዳጀቷን እና የአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናም ውጤት እንደማያመጣ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, abbaa murtii guddaa Iraaq waliin mari'achuun isaanii ibsameera. Ghalibaf, naannichatti haala siyaasaa haaraa ta'e akka uumamaa jiru fi humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa Iraaq gadhiisanii bahuun isaanii injifannoo guddaa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Iran dhiibbaa Ameerikaa waraanaanis ta'e siyaasaan akka moote fi karoora Ameerikaa kan biroo akka fashalsiistu ibsaniiru.

title: Israel destroys Gaza warehouse supplies for malnourished children and pregnant women
english: An Israeli airstrike in central Gaza has destroyed a warehouse containing vital nutritional supplies intended for malnourished children and expectant mothers. The facility, operated by a local charity, suffered extensive structural damage that ruined all stored goods. This loss significantly hampers humanitarian efforts to provide essential care to vulnerable groups facing severe food shortages in the region.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ለተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጦት የተጋለጡ ሕፃናትና እርጉዝ እናቶች የሚጠቀሙበት የዕርዳታ መጋዘን ወድሟል። በአካባቢው የበጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት የሚተዳደረው ይህ መጋዘን ሙሉ በሙሉ በመውደሙ በውስጡ የነበሩ የዕርዳታ ቁሳቁሶች ጥቅም ላይ መዋል አልቻሉም። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ ከፍተኛ የምግብ እጥረት ላለባቸው ተጋላጭ የህብረተሰብ ክፍሎች ድጋፍ ለማድረግ የሚደረገውን የሰብአዊ ጥረት ክፉኛ አሳስሮታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el giddu-galeessa Gazaatti haleellaa qilleensaa gaggeesseen, daa'imman guddina hir'ina qabanifi dubartoota ulfaaf meeshaaleen nyaataa kuufaman barbadaa'aniiru. Qabeenyichi dhaabbata gargaarsa biyya keessaatiin kan to'atamu yoo ta'u, haleellaa kanaan guutummaatti waan manca'eef gargaarsi kun fayyadamtoota bira gahuu hin dandeenye. Kunis rakkoo beelaa cimaa keessa jiran kanneen akka daa'immanii fi dubartootaaf gargaarsa barbaachisaa ta'e dhiyeessuu irratti gufuu guddaa uumeera.

title: US soldier who called for Trump impeachment facing military charges
english: US Air Force Major Jason Watson is facing military charges after publicly demanding the impeachment and removal of President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance. Watson was arrested while protesting in uniform at the Capitol and has openly accused the administration of constitutional violations and corruption. He is now being prosecuted under a rarely used military law that forbids service members from making contemptuous statements against high-ranking government officials.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አየር ኃይል ሜጀር የሆኑት ጄሰን ዋትሰን፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከስልጣናቸው እንዲነሱ በይፋ በመጠየቃቸው በወታደራዊ ክስ እየተጠየቁ ነው። ሜጀር ዋትሰን በዩኒፎርማቸው በካፒቶል ህንፃ ፊት ለፊት ተቃውሞ ሲያሰሙ ተይዘው ነበር፤ መንግስትንም በሙስና እና በህገ-መንግስት ጥሰት ሲከሱ ቆይተዋል። አሁን እየቀረበባቸው ያለው ክስ ወታደራዊ አባላት የሀገሪቱን ከፍተኛ አመራሮች በስድብ መልክ እንዲተቹ የሚከለክለውን ብርቅዬ ወታደራዊ ህግ በመጣስ ነው።
oromo: Mejerii waraana qilleensa Amerikaa Jeeson Waatsan, pirezidaantii Doonaald Traampii fi itti aanaa pirezidaantii Jeey Dii Vaans aangoo irraa akka bu'an waamicha godhaniin himannaan waraanaa irratti banameera. Waatsan uffata waraanaatiin mana maree Amerikaa (Capitol) duratti hiriira bahanitti to'annoo jala oole, mootummaan kun seera cabseera fi malaammaltummaadha keessa jira jechuun himateera. Amma himannaan irratti baname kun seera waraanaa guddina qabu kan miseensonni waraanaa hoogganoota biyyaa irratti dubbii arrabsoo dubbachuu dhowwuudha.

title: US lawmakers urge Trump team to free of American student held by Israel
english: Over 40 US lawmakers have requested that Secretary of State Marco Rubio intervene to secure the release of Sama Safi, a 20-year-old American student held by Israel without charges since June. The legislators expressed grave concern over her worsening health and the inhumane conditions of her detention in the West Bank. They are urging the administration to take immediate action to ensure her safety and facilitate her return home.
amharic: ከ40 በላይ የአሜሪካ የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት አባላት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በኢስራኤል ታስራ የምትገኘውን የ20 ዓመቷን አሜሪካዊት ተማሪ ሳማ ሳፊን በነጻ ለማስለቀቅ እንዲንቀሳቀሱ ጠይቀዋል። የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤቱ አባላት ተማሪዋ በምዕራብ ባንክ ያለ ምንም ክስ በመታሰሯ እና በጤናዋ መበላሸት የተነሳ ከፍተኛ ስጋት እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። አስተዳደሩ የዜግነቷን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ እና ወደ ቤተሰቧ እንድትመለስ አፋጣኝ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Miseensota Kongiresii Ameerikaa 40 ol ta'an, barattuu Ameerikaa waggaa 20 Samaa Saafii jedhamtu kan ji'a Waxabajjii irraa eegalee mootummaan Israa'el himata tokko malee hidhee jirtu akka hiissituuf ministira dhimma alaa Maarkoo Ruubiyootti dhiheessaniiru. Miseensonni kun barattuun kun naannoo Baankiin Dhihaa keessatti haala hamaa keessa waan jirtuuf fayyaan ishee akka badu yaaddoo cimaa qaban ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa jireenya ishee oolchuuf akkasumas gara maatii isheetti akka deebituuf ariitiin tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafataniiru.

title: Syrian Democratic Forces announce their dissolution
english: The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces have officially announced they will disband as an independent military organization. This decision follows a new agreement reached with the Syrian government in Damascus. Previously, the group served as the primary American partner in the fight against ISIL in the region.
amharic: በኩርዶች የሚመሩት የሶሪያ ዴሞክራሲያዊ ኃይሎች እንደ ገለልተኛ ወታደራዊ ቡድን እንደሚፈርስ በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ከሶሪያ መንግሥት ጋር በተደረገ አዲስ ስምምነት መሠረት ነው። ቡድኑ ከዚህ ቀደም በክልሉ አይሲልን በመዋጋት ረገድ የአሜሪካ ዋና አጋር ሆኖ ሲያገለግል ነበር።
oromo: Humnoonni Demookiraatawaa Siiriyaa kan Kurdootaan durfaman, akka dhaabbata waraanaa of danda'eetti akka diigaman beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufte mootummaa Siiriyaa waliin walii galtee haaraa erga mallatteessanii booda. Gareen kun kanaan dura naannichatti ISILin falmachuuf gargaaraa guddaa Ameerikaa ta'ee hojjechaa ture.

title: Real Madrid vs Sociedad: La Liga – prediction, team news, lineups
english: Real Madrid will host Real Sociedad at the Bernabeu stadium on Wednesday in an important La Liga match. This game marks manager Jose Mourinho's first home match since his return to the club. Real Madrid is aiming to secure their second win of the season after narrowly defeating Espanyol in their opening fixture.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ ረቡዕ ዕለት በሳንቲያጎ ቤርናባው ስታዲየም ከሪያል ሶሴዳድ ጋር አስፈላጊ የላሊጋ ጨዋታ ያደርጋል። ይህ ግጥሚያ ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ወደ ክለቡ ከተመለሱ በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በሜዳቸው የሚያደርጉት ጨዋታ ይሆናል። ማድሪድ በመክፈቻ ጨዋታው ኤስፓኞልን በጭንቅ ካሸነፈ በኋላ በዚህ ጨዋታ ተከታታይ ድል ለማስመዝገብ ይጥራል።
oromo: Real Madrid Dilbata har'a siidii Bernabeu keessatti Real Sociedad waliin taphachuu fi tapha La Liga isaanii isa lammaffaa ta'e gaggeessuuf qophiirra jiru. Taphni kun daarektara Jose Mourinho erga deebi'anii booda siidii isaanii keessatti tapha jalqabaa akka ta'e beekameera. Real Madrid tapha jalqabaa Espanyol irratti injifannoo argatan booda, tapha kana injifachuun xiyyeeffannoo isaanii ta'eera.

title: Nigeria launches operation to rescue 600 kidnapped victims
english: Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has ordered a military rescue mission following the mass kidnapping of 600 people from a mosque in Dekera village. The government decided to act after the kidnappers shared footage of the captives on social media platforms. Security forces are now working to locate and safely return the individuals to their homes.
amharic: የናይጄሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት ቦላ አህመድ ቲኑቡ በዴኬራ መንደር ከሚገኝ መስጊድ 600 ሰዎች ታፍነው መወሰዳቸውን ተከትሎ የማዳን ዘመቻ አዘዋል። መንግስት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው ጠላፊዎቹ የታጋቾቹን ምስል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ካሰራጩ በኋላ ነው። የጸጥታ ሃይሎች ታጋቾቹን ለማግኘት እና በሰላም ወደ ቤታቸው ለመመለስ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Naayijeeriyaa Bolaa Ahimad Tiinubuu, namoota 600 ta'an ganduma Dekeraa keessatti masjiida tokko keessaa butamanii booda, duula isaanii fayyisuuf qophaaye ajajanii jiru. Mootummaan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate, buttoonni kun suuraa namoota butaman sana miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti erga gadhiisanii booda. Amma humnoonni nageenyaa namoota kana barbaadanii nagayaan maatii isaanii biraan ga'uuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: New US sanctions signal Trump desperation on Iran, experts say
english: The United States has launched a new set of aggressive economic sanctions against Iran, labeling the move 'Operation Economic Outcast' after failing to achieve a quick military victory. Analysts believe these measures indicate frustration within the Trump administration, as the ongoing conflict has depleted American military resources without forcing Iran to surrender. Despite the economic pressure and previous strikes on leadership, experts remain skeptical that these sanctions will compel Tehran to change its policies or return to negotiations.
amharic: አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ፈጣን ወታደራዊ ድል ማግኘት ባለመቻሏ 'የኢኮኖሚ ውጭ ግዞት ኦፕሬሽን' በሚል አዲስ እና ጠንካራ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን ጥላለች። ተንታኞች እንደሚያምኑት ይህ እርምጃ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በጦርነቱ መጓተት የተሰማውን ተስፋ መቁረጥ ያሳያል፤ ምክንያቱም ግጭቱ የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ አቅም ከመሟጠጡ ውጭ ኢራንን ወደ እጅ እንድትሰጥ አላደረጋትም። ምንም እንኳን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እና የተወሰኑ የኢራን መሪዎች ቢገደሉም፣ እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች ኢራንን ፖሊሲዋን እንድትቀይር ወይም ለድርድር እንድትቀርብ እንደሚያስገድዷት ብዙዎች ጥርጣሬ አላቸው።
oromo: Ameerikaan injifannoo waraanaa ariifachiisaa argachuu dadhabuun, 'Operation Economic Outcast' jedhamuun tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa ta'e Iran irratti fudhatteetti. Akka qorattoonni jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan Trump waraana kana keessatti abdii kutachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha; sababni isaas waraanni kun meeshaalee waraana Ameerikaa fixee malee Iran harka akka kennattu gochuu hin dandeenye. Dhiibbaa diinagdee fi ajajoota Iran irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatame iyyuu, tarkaanfiiwwan haaraan kun Iran siyaasa ishee akka jijjiirtu ykn mariif akka deebitu dirqisiisuu akka danda'an yaadamee hin amanamu.

title: Dolly Parton, beloved US country music icon, dies at 80
english: Legendary American country music icon Dolly Parton has passed away at the age of 80 in Nashville. Renowned for her classic hits, vibrant personality, and philanthropic efforts like her children's literacy programs, she left a lasting legacy on the music industry. Her family and fans worldwide are mourning the loss of the singer who rose from humble beginnings to become a global star.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሀገር ዘፈን (Country music) አቀንቃኝ ዶሊ ፓርተን በ80 ዓመቷ በናሽቪል ማረፏ ተገልጿል። ለታዋቂ የሙዚቃ ስራዎቿ፣ ለደግነቷ እና ለህጻናት የትምህርት ድጋፍ ፕሮግራሞቿ የምትታወቀው አርቲስቷ፣ በአለም ዙሪያ ብዙ አድናቂዎችን ያፈራች ድንቅ ሰው ነበረች። ከድህነት ተነስታ ወደ አለም አቀፍ ዝና ያደገችው የሙዚቃው አለም አዶ ህልፈት በብዙዎች ዘንድ ጥልቅ ሀዘንን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Aartistiin muuziqaa biyya Ameerikaa beekamtuu Dolly Parton waggaa 80tti magaalaa Naashviilitti du'aan addunyaa kanarraa boqatteetti. Parton muuziqawwan isheen beekkamuuf, gaarummaa ishee fi sagantaa gargaarsa barnoota ijoollee isheen geggeessaa turteef kan kabajamtu turte. Hiyyummaa keessaa ka'ee sadarkaa addunyaatti beekkamtii kan argatte Dolly Parton, dhiibbaa guddaa muuziqaa keessatti kan uumte yoo ta'u, duuti ishees gadda guddaa uumeera.

title: What challenge do ‘cockroach’ protests pose for India’s PM Modi?
english: A youth-driven protest movement known as the 'cockroach' demonstrations is creating political pressure for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's administration. Following allegations of police brutality during recent events, India's Supreme Court has mandated an official investigation into the authorities' conduct. As the organizers prepare for further rallies next month, the government faces increasing scrutiny over its handling of these public demonstrations.
amharic: በህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ መንግስት ላይ 'ኮክሮች' ወይም 'ትንኝ' በመባል የሚታወቁ የወጣቶች የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴዎች ጫና እየፈጠሩ ነው። ባለፈው ወር በተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች ወቅት በፖሊስ የደረሰው ጥቃት ምርመራ እንዲደረግበት የህንድ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ሰጥቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የተቃውሞው አስተባባሪዎች ለሚቀጥለው ወር ተጨማሪ ሰልፎችን እያዘጋጁ ሲሆን፣ መንግስት የህዝብ ተቃውሞን በማስተናገድ ረገድ ትልቅ ፈተና ተጋርጦበታል።
oromo: Sochii mormii dargaggootaa 'cockroach' jedhamuun beekamu kun mootummaa muummicha ministeera Indiyaa Narendra Modi irratti dhiibbaa siyaasaa uumaa jira. Mormii darbe irratti poolisiin humna waraanaa fayyadameera jedhamee himatamuu hordofee, mana murtii olaanaa Indiyaatti qorannoon akka gaggeeffamu ajajeera. Qindeessitoonni mormii kun ji'a itti aanu gochaalee biroo akka gaggeessan waan karoorfataniif, mootummaan dhiibbaa ummataa kana akkamitti akka ittisu gaaffii keessa galeera.

title: Trump administration: Kennedy Center may be demolished if repairs not made
english: The Trump administration has warned that the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. faces potential demolition due to significant structural and financial problems. Government lawyers stated that the building will become unsafe and require removal if necessary renovations are not permitted. This threat arose during a legal dispute over the administration's plan to add Donald Trump's name to the venue following recent renovation efforts.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የሚገኘው የኬኔዲ ሴንተር በገንዘብ እና በህንፃው ጥራት ችግር ምክንያት ሊፈርስ እንደሚችል አስታውቋል። የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር ጠበቆች እንደገለጹት አስፈላጊው እድሳት ካልተከናወነ ህንፃው አደገኛ ስለሚሆን መፍረስ ይኖርበታል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የመጣው የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በህንፃው ላይ የራሳቸውን ስም ለማስቀረጽ ካቀዱት እቅድ ጋር በተያያዘ በተፈጠረ የህግ ክርክር ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Trump qajeelcha Waashingtan Diisii kan argamu Kennedy Center rakkoo guddinaafi faayinaansii irraa kan ka'e diigamuu akka danda'u ibseera. Abbootiin seeraa ministeera haqaa akka jedhanitti, suphni barbaachisaa ta'e yoo hin godhamne, gamichi miidhaa nageenyaa waan qabuuf diigamuun isaa hin oolu. Doorsisni kun kan dhufe ergaa mootummaan sun maqaa Donald Trump gamicharratti maxxansuuf karoorfate wajjin walqabatee mormiin seeraa erga ka'ee booda.

title: Video: US country music legend Dolly Parton dies
english: Renowned American country music icon Dolly Parton has passed away at the age of 80. Her family confirmed the sad news through a social media video announcement. She was widely celebrated for her legendary hits, including Jolene, 9 to 5, and I Will Always Love You.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ አሜሪካዊት የገጠር ሙዚቃ ኮከብ ዶሊ ፓርተን በ80 ዓመቷ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይታለች። ቤተሰቦቿ ይህንን አሳዛኝ ዜና በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በለቀቁት ቪዲዮ አማካኝነት አረጋግጠዋል። ድምጻዊቷ እንደ ጆሊን፣ 9 ቱ 5 እና አይ ዊል ኦልዌይስ ሎቭ ዩ ባሉ ተወዳጅ ዘፈኖቿ ትታወቅ ነበር።
oromo: Weerraa muuziqaa biyyaa Ameerikaa beekamtuun Dolly Parton umurii ishee waggaa 80tti du'aan addunyaa kanarraa boqatteetti. Maatiin ishee oduu gaddisiisaa kana viidiyoo miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti gadhiisaniin mirkaneessaniiru. Isheen sirboota ishee beekamoo kanneen akka Jolene, 9 to 5 fi I Will Always Love You jedhamaniin baay'ee jaallatamti turte.

title: Iran, Oman discuss temporary shipping lane through Strait of Hormuz
english: Iran and Oman are currently discussing a proposal to establish a temporary shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz to improve maritime navigation. The initiative includes a collaborative project to remove mines from the waterway and aims to set up systems for better traffic management and security. Both nations hope this temporary measure will eventually lead to a permanent, regulated transit solution that respects regional sovereignty.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር በኩል ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ ማለፊያ መስመር ለመፍጠር እየተወያዩ ነው። ይህ እቅድ በውሃ መንገዱ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ፈንጂዎችን ለማጽዳት እና የትራፊክ ፍሰትን በዘመናዊ መንገድ ለመቆጣጠር ያለመ ነው። ሁለቱ አገራት ይህንን ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት የክልሉን ሉዓላዊነት በሚያከብር መልኩ ወደ ቋሚ የመርከብ ማለፊያ ሥርዓት ለመቀየር እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Iraaniifi Omaanni karaa markabootaa kan yeroo dabarsu daandii Hormuz keessa jiru irratti mari'achaa jiru. Karoorri kun bakka kanatti kan argaman miinoota ykn boombiiwwan gaggaabbattoon qulqulleessuu fi to'annoo geejjibaa fooyyessuu kan kaayyeeffate dha. Mootummootni lamaanuu tarkaanfiin yeroof fudhatame kun gara fuulduraatti karaa dhaabbataa kan kabaja biyyoota ollaa eegu ta'e akka fidu abdatu.

title: Trump's 'Board of Peace' warns Hamas against flying kites
english: A peace supervisory committee led by the United States has officially warned Hamas to halt the practice of flying kites in Gaza. This directive follows threats from Israel to launch military retaliation if the activities continue. Officials have communicated this demand through formal channels to ensure all militant actions in the region are brought to an end.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም አስከባሪ ኮሚቴ ሀማስ በጋዛ የካይት (የወረቀት ላይ ካይት) መንቀሳቀሱን እንዲያቆም ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥቷል። ይህ መመሪያ የተላለፈው እስራኤል ድርጊቱ ካልቆመ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ ካስጠነቀቀች በኋላ ነው። ኮሚቴው በክልሉ የሚደረጉ ሁሉም ታጣቂ እንቅስቃሴዎች በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆሙ በይፋዊ መንገድ መልዕክቱን አስተላልፏል።
oromo: Koreen nageenyaa Ameerikaan durfamu tokko, gareen Hamaas gaazaatti oobii (kite) balaliisuu akka dhaabu akeekkachiiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga Israa'el hojiileen akkasii yoo itti fufan haleellaa waraanaa akka geessisuu himtee booda. Koreen kun, gochi waraanummaa kamiyyuu naannichatti akka dhaabatu karaa sirnaa ergaa isaa dabarseera.

title: Iran’s deputy foreign minister says Hormuz to remain closed despite temporary Oman deal
english: Iranian official Kazem Gharibabadi announced that the Strait of Hormuz will stay under Iranian control despite a new temporary transit deal reached with Oman. While a narrow seven-mile passage through Iranian waters has been established, Tehran insists that broader access remains restricted due to their ongoing state of war. Iran maintains that all maritime routes in the region must operate solely according to their own established security arrangements.
amharic: የኢራን ምክትል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ካዜም ጋሪባባዲ የሆርሙዝ የባህር መንገድ ከኦማን ጋር ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት ቢደረግም አሁንም በኢራን ቁጥጥር ስር እንደሚቆይ አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን በጦርነት ውስጥ እንደምትገኝ የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ በባህር ዳርቻዋ በኩል የተፈቀደው ጠባብ መንገድ ብቻ ተግባራዊ እንደሚሆንና ሌላኛው የባህር መስመር መዘጋቱን ተናግረዋል። በክልሉ የሚደረጉ የባህር ላይ እንቅስቃሴዎች በሙሉ በኢራን ቁጥጥር እና ፈቃድ ብቻ መከናወን እንዳለባቸውም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iraan akka ibsanitti, Hormuziin hanga ammaatti to'annoo Iraan jala akka ta'uufi waliigalteen Oomaan waliin ta'e kunis yeroof qofa akka ta'e beekameera. Iraan yeroo ammaa kana haala waraana keessa akka jirtu ibsuun, daandiiwwan galaana naannoo sanaa hundi seera isaanii qofa hordofuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru. Kana malees, daandiin galaana naannoo sanaa gara biraa Iraan bakka fedhetti qofa kan banamu ta'uu fi to'annoo isaanii ala akka hin taane ibsaniiru.

title: Top Iranian officials mock US 'economic D-Day' on social media
english: Prominent Iranian officials are ridiculing U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s recent threats of harsh new economic sanctions, which he described as an 'economic D-Day.' Tehran representatives mocked the rhetoric, suggesting the U.S. strategy is disorganized and potentially damaging to the global financial system. They argue that these coercive measures represent an overreach that forces international entities to choose between American demands and their own economic interests.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት የአሜሪካው የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት 'ኢኮኖሚያዊ ዲ-ዴይ' ብለው የገለጹትን አዲስ ማዕቀብ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመጠቀም እየተሳለቁበት ይገኛሉ። የኢራን አመራሮች የአሜሪካ ስትራቴጂ ግራ የተጋባ እና ለአለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ አደገኛ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ ተችተውታል። እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች የአሜሪካን ፍላጎት ለመፈጸም በሌሎች ሀገራት እና ኩባንያዎች ላይ የሚደረግ ግፊት መሆኑን በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoon Iraan ibsa ministira maallaqa Ameerikaa Scott Bessent kan 'Economic D-Day' jedhamee waamamee fi tarkaatiiwwan diinagdee haarawaa irratti gaaffii kaasaniiru. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Iraan mala Ameerikaa kanaan dursee qophii kan hin qabne fi diinagdee addunyaaf balaa kan qabu ta'uu dubbatu. Tarkaatiin kun biyyoota fi dhaabbilee addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun, fedhii Ameerikaa hordofuu ykn adabbii fudhachuu akka filatan kan dirqisiisu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Bangladesh could join Mecca pact, official suggests
english: Bangladesh is considering an invitation to join the 'Mecca pact,' a collective defense agreement currently involving Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan. If the country joins, it would mark a significant shift in its foreign policy, as the agreement functions similarly to NATO by treating an attack on one member as an attack on all. This move could complicate regional dynamics, particularly regarding Bangladesh's relationship with neighboring India.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመውን 'የመካ ስምምነት' ተብሎ የሚጠራውን የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ለመቀላቀል ግብዣ እንደቀረበላት አስታውቃለች። አገሪቱ ስምምነቱን ከተቀላቀለች፣ በአንድ አባል ላይ የሚደርስ ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደደረሰ የሚቆጠርበትን የኔቶ መሰል የጋራ መከላከያ ስትራቴጂ ትቀላቀላለች ማለት ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የባንግላዲሽን የውጭ ግንኙነት ፖሊሲ ከመቀየሩም በላይ፣ በተለይም ከህንድ ጋር ባላት ግንኙነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ሊያሳድር ይችላል።
oromo: Baangilaadesh biyyoota Saudii Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffamee fi 'Walii galtee Makkaa' jedhamee beekamu kan ittisa waliinii keessatti hirmaachuuf affeerraa akka argatte ibsiteetti. Biyyi kun yoo waliigaltee kana keessatti hirmaatte, akkaataa heera NATOtti biyya tokko irratti miidhaan yoo ga’e, hunda irratti akka ga’etti lakkaa’ama. Tarkaanfiin kun siyaasa biyyattii fi hariiroo isheen ollaa ishee Hindii wajjin qabdu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa fiduu danda’a.

title: Mass arrests in global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks
english: Interpol recently led an international crackdown known as Operation Jackal IV, which resulted in the arrest of 58 individuals across 22 countries. This initiative targeted organized West African cyber-crime networks responsible for romance scams, investment fraud, and the exploitation of minors through sextortion. By tracking illicit financial flows and freezing numerous bank accounts, law enforcement officials aim to dismantle the economic foundations of these violent criminal organizations.
amharic: ኢንተርፖል በቅርቡ 'ኦፕሬሽን ጃካል ፎር' በተባለ ዓለም አቀፍ ዘመቻ በ22 አገሮች ውስጥ 58 የሳይበር ወንጀለኞችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ይህ ዘመቻ የፍቅር ማታለያዎችን፣ የኢንቨስትመንት ማጭበርበርን እና ህጻናትን ለብዝበዛ የሚያጋልጡ የምዕራብ አፍሪካ የሳይበር ወንጀል ቡድኖችን ኢላማ ያደረገ ነበር። የሕግ አስከባሪ አካላት ሕገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ዝውውሮችን በመከታተል እና የባንክ ሂሳቦችን በማገድ የእነዚህን የወንጀል ድርጅቶች የገቢ ምንጭ ለማዳከም እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Interpol ergii 'Operation Jackal IV' jedhamuun qindaa'e kanaan, biyyoota 22 keessatti shakkamtoota 58 to'annoo jala oolcheera. Tarkaanfiin kun garee yakka interneetii kan Afrikaa Lixaa ta'anii, oduu jaalalaa sobaa, gowwoomsa invastimantii fi miidhaa ijoollee irratti xiyyeeffachaa turan kan irratti xiyyeeffate dha. Mootummoonni fi dhaabbileen nageenyaa addunyaa, hariiroo maallaqaa seeraan alaa hordofuudhaan fi akaawuntii baankii hedduu cufuudhaan, bu'uura dinagdee garee yakka kanaa diiguuf carraaqaa jiru.

title: More than 1,300 people arrested by ICE in Virginia and Maryland
english: U.S. immigration authorities recently conducted a large-scale enforcement operation in Virginia and Maryland. Over the span of two weeks, more than 1,300 individuals were taken into custody. Federal officials have characterized this mission as a highly significant achievement for the agency.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ ባለስልጣናት በቨርጂኒያ እና ሜሪላንድ ግዛቶች መጠነ ሰፊ የሆነ ህግ የማስከበር ስራ አካሂደዋል። ባለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ ብቻ ከ1,300 በላይ የሚሆኑ ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። የፌደራል መንግስት አካላት ይህንን ተልዕኮ በኤጀንሲው ታሪክ ውስጥ እጅግ ውጤታማ ከሆኑ ስራዎች አንዱ እንደሆነ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa godaantotaa fi gumurukaa Ameerikaa, naannoowwan Virjiiniyaa fi Meeriilaand keessatti qophii guddaa taasisuun namoota baay'ee qabaniiru. Torban lamaan darban keessatti namoonni 1,300 ol ta'an to'annaa jala oolaniiru. Qaamoleen mootummaa federaalaa hojiin kun seenaa dhaabbatichaa keessatti injifannoo guddaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in US state of Pennsylvania
english: Two unvaccinated individuals in Pennsylvania have passed away from measles, representing the first deaths from this preventable disease in the state this year. Health officials are concerned as national vaccination rates decline, leading to a significant surge in cases across the country. This trend is being fueled by an anti-vaccine movement and recent government policies that challenge long-standing scientific recommendations regarding immunization.
amharic: በፔንሲልቬንያ ግዛት ሁለት ክትባት ያልወሰዱ ሰዎች በኩፍኝ በሽታ ህይወታቸው አልፏል፤ ይህም በግዛቲቱ ዘንድሮ የተመዘገበ የመጀመሪያው የሞት ክስተት ነው። በሀገሪቱ የክትባት መጠን እየቀነሰ በመምጣቱ የኩፍኝ በሽታ ስርጭት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ መምጣቱ የጤና ባለሙያዎችን አሳስቧል። ይህ የክትባት መቀነስ አዝማሚያ የክትባት ተቃዋሚ እንቅስቃሴዎች እና ሳይንሳዊ ምክረ-ሃሳቦችን የሚቃወሙ የመንግስት ውሳኔዎች እየጨመሩ በመምጣታቸው የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaa Pensilveeniyaa keessatti namoonni lama talaallii hin fudhanne dhukkuba kofniitiin du’aniiru; kunis waggaa kana keessatti du’a dhukkuba kanaan walqabatee ganda sana keessatti galmaa’e isa jalqabaati. Sadarkaa biyyaalessatti talaallii fudhachuun hir’achaa waan dhufeef, dhukkubni kun saffisaan babal’achaa jiraachuun isaa ogeeyyota fayyaa yaaddoo guddaa keessa galcheera. Rakkoon kun kan dhufe sochii talaallii mormuu fi murtee mootummaa saayinsii irratti hundaa’e tuffatu hordofee dha.

title: Israeli forces block Palestinian American Lou Ridi from walking on his land
english: Palestinian American Lou Ridi was prevented by Israeli military forces from accessing his own property in the village of Qusra. Ridi had returned to protect his family home amid increasing tensions and settler presence in the area. While the soldiers claimed they were present to manage security, they prohibited Ridi from walking on his land while allowing settlers to move through the vicinity without restriction.
amharic: አሜሪካዊው ፍልስጤማዊ ሉ ሪዲ በኩስራ መንደር የሚገኘውን የቤተሰብ መሬቱን እንዳይጠቀም በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ተከልክሏል። ሪዲ ወደ አካባቢው የተመለሰው በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን የስደተኞች እንቅስቃሴ እና የጸጥታ ስጋት ተከትሎ ቤተሰቡን ለመጠበቅ ነበር። ወታደሮቹ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ እዚያ እንዳሉ ቢገልጹም፣ ስደተኞች በነፃነት እንዲንቀሳቀሱ ፈቅደው ለባለቤቱ ግን መሬቱ ላይ እንዳይራመድ እገዳ ጥለውበታል።
oromo: Lubbuu Ridiin kan jedhamu lammiin Ameerikaa fi Falastiiniin, qabeenya maatii isaa kan ganda Qusraa keessatti argamu akka hin fayyadamne humnoonni waraana Israa'el dhorkaniiru. Ridiin gara naannichatti kan deebi'e, weerara qe'ee qabanirratti xiyyeeffachuudhaan maatii isaa eeguuf ture. Waraanni Israa'el nagaa eeguuf akka jiran kan dubbatan ta'us, namoonni biyyee qaban (settlers) akka fedhan akka deddeebi'an hayyamanii, abbaan qabeenyichaa garuu lafa isaarratti akka hin sochoone dhorkaniiru.

title: India police clash with protesters a month after Gen Z demonstrations
english: In Patna, India, police used water cannons and batons to disperse thousands of demonstrators protesting against high unemployment and corruption in recruitment exams. These protests follow a previous wave of youth-led unrest in New Delhi that led to the resignation of the country's education minister. While local authorities have detained several protesters and accused them of violence, government officials have initiated talks with student representatives to address their concerns regarding job security.
amharic: በህንድ ፓትና ከተማ፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች የስራ አጥነት ችግርን እና በምልመላ ፈተናዎች ላይ የሚታየውን ኢ-ፍትሃዊነት በመቃወም ሰልፍ ሲወጡ ፖሊስ የውሃ መድፍ እና በትሮችን በመጠቀም ለመበተን ሞክሯል። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች ቀደም ሲል በኒው ዴልሂ ተቀስቅሰው የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩን ስልጣን እንዲለቁ ያደረጉትን የተማሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ ተከትሎ የመጡ ናቸው። ባለስልጣናት በአመጽ የጠረጠሯቸውን ሰልፈኞች በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ቢሆንም፣ የተማሪዎችን ጥያቄ ለመመለስ ከወኪሎቻቸው ጋር ውይይት መጀመራቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Indiyaa magaalaa Patnaa keessatti, dargaggoonni kumaan lakkaawwaman hoji dhabdummaa fi qormaata ramaddii keessatti gowwoomsaa jiraachuu mormuudhaan hiriira ba'an poolisiin bishaan humnaan dhiibuu fi uleedhaan bittimseera. Mormiin kun mormii dargaggootaa New Delhi keessatti ka'ee ministira barnootaa aangoo irraa buuse booda kan dhufe dha. Mootummaan namoota mormii irratti hirmaatan tokko tokko qabuu fi garee barattootaa waliin marii eegaluus ibsameera.

title: Kurdish-led forces in Syria dissolve after merging with the army
english: The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces have officially dissolved after merging into the national Syrian army. This decision follows a peace agreement reached with the government in Damascus after the group lost control of its northeastern territories. As part of the deal, the government has also committed to protecting Kurdish cultural rights, including the right to provide education in the Kurdish language.
amharic: በኩርድ የሚመሩት የሶሪያ ዴሞክራቲክ ኃይሎች ከሶሪያ ብሔራዊ ጦር ጋር በመዋሃዳቸው ምክንያት መፍረሳቸውን በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው ቡድኑ በሰሜን ምስራቅ ሶሪያ የነበረውን ቁጥጥር ካጣ በኋላ ከደማስቆ መንግስት ጋር በተፈራረሙት የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት ነው። ስምምነቱ የኩርድ ቋንቋን በትምህርት ቤቶች የመጠቀም መብትን ጨምሮ የኩርድ ማህበረሰብ ባህላዊ መብቶች እንዲጠበቁ ያደርጋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Demokiraatawaa Siiriyaa kan Kuurdotaan durfaman, gara waraana biyyoolessa Siiriyaatti makamuudhaan gadi ba’uu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufu, gareen kun naannolee kaaba-bahaa to’annoo isaa jala turan erga dhabee booda mootummaa Siiriyaa waliin walii galtee nagaa erga godhee booda. Walii galtee kanaan, mootummaan mirga aadaa Kuurdotaa kabajuuf fi barnoota afaan Kuurdiitiin kennuuf waadaa galeera.

title: Israeli protesters block aid trucks from reaching Gaza
english: Israeli protesters gathered at the Kerem Shalom crossing to obstruct trucks delivering humanitarian aid to Gaza. The demonstrators are calling for the complete disarmament of Hamas before any reconstruction begins. Additionally, they are voicing their strong opposition to the potential deployment of an international peacekeeping force in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ተቃዋሚዎች ወደ ጋዛ የሚሄዱ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ መኪኖችን በኬሬም ሻሎም መተላለፊያ ላይ በማቆም መንገድ ዘግተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ሃማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ ሳይፈታ የጋዛ መልሶ ግንባታ ሊጀመር አይገባም የሚል አቋም አላቸው። በተጨማሪም በክልሉ ውስጥ ዓለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል እንዲሰማራ እንደሚቃወሙ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hiriirtonni Israa'el daandii cehumsa Kerem Shalom irratti gadi bahuun konkolaattoota gargaarsa namoomaa gara Gaazaa imalaa turan ittisan. Hiriirtonni kunneen haala deebisanii ijaaruun dura dhaabbata Hamaas guutummaatti meeshaa hiikachuu akka qabu gaafatu. Kana malees, naannichatti humnoonni nageenya eegsisuuf gargaaran idil-addunyaa akka hin ramadamne mormii isaanii dhageessisaniiru.

title: Turkey won’t abandon Syria or let Israel draw ‘red lines’, Erdogan says
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has rejected Israel's claims regarding a recent airstrike on a Syrian airbase, asserting that Turkey will continue to support its regional partners. While Israel labeled the Turkish presence at the site as a violation of their 'red lines,' both Ankara and the U.S. maintain that the work was only for maintenance purposes. Erdogan stated that outside powers will not dictate Turkey's foreign policy or influence its military activities in the area.
amharic: የቱርኩ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶጋን እስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ የፈጸመችውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የሰጡትን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። እስራኤል በቦታው ላይ የቱርክ ወታደራዊ መገኘት የራሷን 'ቀይ መስመር' እንደሚጥስ ብትገልጽም፣ ቱርክ ጣቢያው ለጥገና ስራ ብቻ ጥቅም ላይ እንደዋለ አረጋግጣለች። የቱርክ መንግስት የውጭ ኃይላት የቱርክን የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ሊወስኑ አይችሉም በማለት አቋሙን በጽኑ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Turkii Recep Tayyip Erdogan haleellaa Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaa irratti raawwatte kan balaaleffatan yoo ta'u, Turkii fi michoota ishee giddutti hidhata jiru kabajuun akka itti fufu ibsaniiru. Israa'el buufata kanatti hojiin Turkii daangaa ishee akka darbetti ibsituus, Turkii fi Ameerikaan hojiin achitti hojjetamaa ture kan suphaa qofa akka ta'e mirkaneessaniiru. Erdogan, humnootni alaa aangoo dhabanii siyaasa alaa Turkii murteessuu akka hin dandeenye ifatti dubbataniiru.

title: Arms trade watchdog says countries are failing in their obligations to report weapons trade
english: A global watchdog group reports that most countries are failing to disclose their weapons trading activities as required by an international treaty. Out of the 118 nations involved in the agreement, less than 40 percent provided their mandated reports on time this year. Experts warn that this lack of transparency is especially concerning given the current rise in global military spending and widespread international conflicts.
amharic: አለም አቀፍ የጦር መሳሪያ ንግድን የሚከታተል ተቋም አብዛኛዎቹ ሀገራት በስምምነቱ መሰረት የጦር መሳሪያ ልውውጣቸውን ግልጽ እያደረጉ እንዳልሆነ አስታውቋል። በስምምነቱ ከተካተቱት 118 ሀገራት መካከል ከ40 በመቶ በታች የሚሆኑት ብቻ በወቅቱ ሪፖርት ማቅረብ ችለዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚሉት ይህ የግልጽነት መጓደል በአሁኑ ወቅት የጦር መሳሪያ ወጪዎች እየጨመሩ እና ግጭቶች እየተባባሱ ባለበት ወቅት እጅግ አሳሳቢ ነው።
oromo: Hordoffiin gabaa meeshaa waraanaa addunyaa akka ibsetti, biyyoonni hedduun walii galtee idil-addunyaa irratti mallatteessan guutuuf qulqullinaan gabaasa dhiyeessaa hin jiran. Biyyoota 118 walii galtee kana keessa jiran keessaa, kanneen dhibbeentaa 40 gadi ta'an qofaatu yeroon gabaasa isaanii dhiyeessan. Ogeeyyoonni akka ibsanitti, haalli iftoomina dhabuu kun yeroo baay'een waraanaaf ooluu fi walitti buutiin addunyaa irratti dabalaa jiru kanatti baay'ee yaaddessaa dha.

title: Iran foreign minister holds talks with Pakistani, Qatari officials
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi recently held separate phone discussions with the Qatari Prime Minister and the Pakistani army chief. The primary focus of these talks was to address rising regional tensions and explore diplomatic solutions. Both parties agreed on the need for ongoing collaboration to foster peace and stability throughout the area.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ከኳታር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር እና ከፓኪስታን የጦር ኃይሎች አዛዥ ጋር በተለያዩ የስልክ ውይይቶች ተወያይተዋል። የውይይቱ ዋና ትኩረት በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት መቆጣጠር እና የዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎችን መፈለግ ነው። ሁለቱም ወገኖች በአካባቢው ሰላምን እና መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን በትብብር መስራት እንደሚያስፈልግ ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchiin, Ministira Muummee Qaxar fi ajajaa waraana Paakistaan wajjin bilbilan mari’ataniiru. Mariin kun kan xiyyeeffate waldhabiinsa naannichatti dabalaa jiru tasgabbeessuu fi furmaata diippilomaasii barbaaduu irratti dha. Gamachuun isaaniis, nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichatti buusuuf waliin hojjechuun barbaachisaa ta’uu irratti waliigalaniru.

title: Head of Kurdish forces in Syria announces their dissolution
english: Mazloum Abdi, the commander of the Syrian Democratic Forces, has officially declared that the military group is disbanding. This decision is part of an agreement made with the new governing authorities in Damascus. The SDF, which was established in 2015, had played a major role in the coalition efforts to defeat the Islamic State.
amharic: የሶሪያ ዴሞክራቲክ ኃይሎች መሪ ማዝሉም አብዲ ቡድኑ በይፋ መፍረሱን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከደማስቆ አዲሱ አስተዳደር ጋር በተደረገ ስምምነት መሰረት የተወሰደ ነው። እ.ኤ.አ በ2015 የተቋቋመው ይህ ቡድን እስላማዊ መንግስትን (ISIS) በመዋጋት ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ሲጫወት ቆይቷል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana 'Syrian Democratic Forces' (SDF) Mazloum Abdi, humnoonni kun hojii isaanii dhaabanii akka bittinnaa'an ifatti beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun mootummaa Damascus waliin walii galtee ta'e irratti hundaa'a. Humnoonni SDF bara 2015 kan hundaa'an yoo ta'u, garee IS (Islamic State) irratti duula gaggeeffame keessatti gahee guddaa qabaachaa turan.

title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
english: Canada is introducing retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on approximately $20 billion worth of American products, including steel and furniture. This move comes after trade negotiations failed and the U.S. imposed its own levies on Canadian imports. The Canadian government intends for these measures to be proportionate, while also providing financial support to local businesses affected by the trade dispute.
amharic: ካናዳ በአሜሪካ የብረታ ብረትና የቤት ዕቃዎች ምርቶች ላይ እስከ 50 በመቶ የሚደርስ የበቀል የንግድ ቀረጥ እንደምትጥል አስታውቃለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው የሁለቱ አገራት የንግድ ድርድር በመቋረጡ እና አሜሪካ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ ቀረጥ በመጣሏ ምክንያት ነው። ካናዳ ይህ እርምጃ ተመጣጣኝ እንደሆነ የገለጸች ሲሆን፣ በንግድ ግጭቱ ለተጎዱ አገር በቀል ድርጅቶችም የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደምታደርግ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Kanaadaan oomishaalee Ameerikaa kanneen akka sibiilaa fi meeshaalee mana keessaa irratti gibira hanga dhibbeentaa 50 ga'u akka murteessite beeksisiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga mariin daldalaa isaanii fashaleenii fi Ameerikaan oomishaalee Kanaadaa irratti gibira kaastee booda. Kanaadaan tarkaanfichi kan madaalame ta'uu fi dhaabbilee gibirichi miidhu gargaaruuf gargaarsa maallaqaa akka kennitu ibsiteetti.

title: Syria’s economy poised for improvement after US sanctions removal
english: The United States has officially removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism, ending a designation that had been in place since 1979. This decision removes the final major barrier preventing Syria from re-entering the international financial system after years of isolation and civil war. Experts believe this change will provide a significant economic boost as the country begins to rebuild under its new government.
amharic: አሜሪካ ሶሪያን ከሽብርተኝነት ስፖንሰር አድራጊ አገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ በይፋ ሰርዛለች፣ ይህም ከ1979 ጀምሮ የነበረውን ማዕቀብ አብቅቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ ሶሪያ ከረጅም ዓመታት ጦርነት እና ማግለል በኋላ ወደ ዓለም አቀፍ የፋይናንስ ሥርዓት እንድትመለስ ትልቅ እንቅፋት የነበረውን ሁኔታ ያስወግድላታል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ አዲሱ የሶሪያ መንግሥት አገሪቱን መልሶ ለመገንባት በሚጥርበት በዚህ ወቅት ይህ እርምጃ ለኢኮኖሚው ትልቅ መነቃቃትን ይፈጥራል።
oromo: Amerikaa sirnaan mootummaa Suuriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota gargaaran keessaa baasteerti; kunis waggaa 1979 irraa jalqabee kan turu ture. Murtoon kun Suuriyaan waraana fi adda baatee turte booda, gara sirna faayinaansii addunyaatti akka deebituuf gufuu guddaa turre irraa kaasa. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, jijjiirramni kun mootummaan haarawaa biyyattii deebisee ijaaruuf carraaqqii godhu keessatti dinagdee biyyattii sadarkaa gaariirra gahuuf gargaara.

title: Syria ‘shakes off’ past with removal from US ‘terror list’, says al-Sharaa
english: The United States has removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism, a significant move intended to support the country's post-war economic recovery and reconstruction. Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa welcomed the decision, viewing it as a way to move past a difficult history and attract necessary international investment. While this change eases decades of economic sanctions, U.S. officials emphasized that they will continue to monitor and hold individuals accountable for any future involvement in terrorism.
amharic: አሜሪካ ሶሪያን ከአሸባሪዎች ደጋፊ ሀገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ ሰርዛለች፤ ይህ ውሳኔ ሀገሪቱ ከጦርነት በኋላ ለምትፈልገው የኢኮኖሚ ግንባታና መልሶ ማቋቋም ወሳኝ ነው። የሶሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ውሳኔውን የሀገሪቱን አስቸጋሪ ታሪክ በመዝጋት ወደ ልማት ለመሸጋገር እንደሚያግዝ ገልጸዋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው፣ ይህ ውሳኔ የኢኮኖሚ እቀባን የሚያነሳ ቢሆንም፣ በቀጣይም ቢሆን ከአሸባሪነት ጋር በተያያዘ ጥብቅ ክትትል እንደሚያደርጉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa biyya Suuriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota deggeran keessaa haxooftetti; tarkaanfichi biyyattii erga waraana booda deebitee ijaaramuuf gargaara. Pireezidaantiin Suuriyaa Ahimad Al-Shaaraa, murtoon kun seenaa darbe duubatti dhiisanii gara misoomaatti ce'uuf kan isaan gargaaru ta'uu ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Amerikaa gama isaatiin, tarkaanfichi uggura diinagdee irraa bilisa baasuus, gara fuulduraatti shororkeessummaa wajjin walqabatee haala jiru irratti hordoffiin cimaan akka itti fufu ibseera.

title: Kremlin denies planned talks with US envoys amid reports CIA head in Russia
english: CIA Director John Ratcliffe is reported to be in Moscow for a high-level visit, marking the first such trip by a Trump administration official since January. While the Kremlin has officially denied that any formal talks are scheduled, flight tracking data confirmed a US military aircraft arrived in and departed from the Russian capital. Washington reportedly requested that Ukraine pause its military strikes in the area until the American delegation completes its visit.
amharic: የሲአይኤ ዳይሬክተር ጆን ራትክሊፍ በሩሲያ ዋና ከተማ ሞስኮ ጉብኝት እያደረጉ መሆኑ ተሰምቷል፤ ይህም ከጥር ወር በኋላ በአሜሪካ መንግስት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን ሲደረግ የመጀመሪያው ጉብኝት ነው። ምንም እንኳን የክሬምሊን ቃል አቀባይ ምንም አይነት ኦፊሴላዊ ውይይቶች እንደሌሉ ቢክዱም፣ የበረራ መረጃዎች የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ወደ ሞስኮ ተጉዞ እንደነበር አረጋግጠዋል። ዋሽንግተን የአሜሪካው ልዑክ አካባቢውን እስኪለቅ ድረስ ዩክሬን ጥቃቷን እንድታቆም መጠየቋም ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Hoogganaan waajjira qorannoo CIA John Ratcliffe gara magaala guddoo Ruusiyaa Mooskoo deemanii akka jiran gabaafameera; kunis bara 2026 keessa hoggantoota mootummaa Ameerikaa irraa imala sadarkaa olaanaa jalqabaati. Yeroo Mootummaan Ruusiyaa mariin kamiyyuu akka hin jirre ibse, odeeffannoon balalii xiyyaara waraanaa Ameerikaa tokko gara Mooskoo akka deeme fi deebi'e mirkaneesseera. Washington guca irratti, ergaa ergaa ergame kun bakka sana hanga gadhiisutti Yukreen lola ishee akka dhaabdu gaafachuu ishee gabaafameera.

title: Fatah, Dahlan bloc hold reconciliation talks ahead of Palestinian elections
english: Representatives from the Fatah movement and Mohammed Dahlan’s Democratic Reform bloc have met in Egypt to discuss reconciliation ahead of upcoming Palestinian legislative elections. This meeting follows reports that Dahlan’s group might join forces with Hamas to create a powerful opposition coalition. While the talks were described as positive, no formal agreements have been reached yet, as Fatah faces pressure to resolve internal disputes.
amharic: የፈታህ ንቅናቄ እና መሐመድ ዳህላን የሚመሩት የዴሞክራቲክ ሪፎርም ቡድን በቅርቡ ለሚካሄደው የፍልስጤም ምርጫ በመዘጋጀት በግብፅ ውይይት አድርገዋል። የዳህላን ቡድን ከሀማስ ጋር በመቀናጀት ጠንካራ የተቃዋሚ ጥምረት ሊፈጥር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት በተፈጠረበት ወቅት ነው ይህ ስብሰባ የተካሄደው። ውይይቱ በአዎንታዊ መልኩ ቢጀመርም፣ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ተግባራዊ ስምምነት ላይ አልተደረሰም።
oromo: Mootummaan Paalistayinii fi gareen Mohammed Dahlan kan 'Democratic Reform' jedhamu, filannoo dhufuuf qophii ta'uun hariiroo isaanii fooyyeffachuuf biyya Masriitti mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun kan gaggeeffame, gareen Dahlan kun dhaaba Haamaas waliin ta'uun mormituu cimaa ta'uu danda'u hundeessuuf yaada qabaachuu isaatiin sodaatamee ture. Mariin sun haala gaariin kan jalqabame ta'us, hamma ammaatti waliigalteen lafarra oolu irra ga'amuu isaa ifa hin taane.

title: Spain requests emergency funding from the EU over Ceuta migrants
english: Spain has officially asked the European Union for emergency financial support to manage a severe migration crisis in the North African territory of Ceuta. This follows a mass surge of roughly 70,000 migrants last July, which led to significant loss of life and overwhelmed local resources. The Spanish government is now establishing a new central command to speed up the repatriation process for remaining migrants while ensuring legal and humanitarian standards are upheld.
amharic: ስፔን በሰሜን አፍሪካ ግዛቷ ሴውታ የተከሰተውን የፍልሰት ቀውስ ለመቆጣጠር ከአውሮፓ ህብረት አስቸኳይ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ጠየቀች። ጥያቄው የቀረበው በባለፈው ሐምሌ ወር ወደ 70,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች ድንበሩን ጥሰው በመግባታቸው ምክንያት ለተፈጠረው ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና ጫና ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። የስፔን መንግስት የቀሩትን ስደተኞች ወደ ሀገራቸው የመመለስ ሂደቱን ለማፋጠን አዲስ ማዕከላዊ የትዕዛዝ መዋቅር መዘርጋቱን እና አስፈላጊውን የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እያደረገ መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Ispeeniin naannoo Kaaba Afrikaa kan taate Ceuta keessatti rakkoo godaantotaa mudate hordofee gargaarsa ariifataa gamtaa Awurooppaa gaafatteetti. Kana kan ta'e, ji'a darbe keessa godaantota kuma 70 ol ta'an daangaa ce'uun isaanii lubbuun akka darbuu fi rakkoo hamaa akka uumu hordofeeti. Mootummaan Ispeen godaantota achi hafan gara biyya isaaniitti deebisuu ariifachiisuuf abbaa taayitaa giddugaleessaa haaraa dhaabeera; kana cinaattis gargaarsa namoomaa kennuuf itti fufeera.

title: Most US Democrats in early 2028 primary states oppose aid to Israel: Poll
english: A recent poll shows that a majority of Democratic voters in the first six states to hold 2028 primaries oppose sending military aid to Israel. Many of these voters believe Israel is committing genocide in Gaza and support measures like sanctions and legal actions against Israeli leadership. This shift suggests that traditional support for Israel among the Democratic base has significantly declined, which could impact the party's future policy positions.
amharic: በቅርቡ ይፋ የሆነ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በ2028 የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ መጀመሪያ ላይ ድምጽ በሚሰጡ ስድስት ግዛቶች የሚገኙ አብዛኛዎቹ የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ደጋፊዎች ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርዳታ መስጠትን ይቃወማሉ። ብዙዎቹ መራጮች እስራኤል በጋዛ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል እየፈጸመች ነው ብለው እንደሚያምኑ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጣል እና በதலைኞቿ ላይ የህግ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ድጋፍ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ለውጥ በዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ለእስራኤል የነበረው ድጋፍ በእጅጉ መቀነሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: qorannoon haaraan tokko akka agarsiisutti, namoonni waggaa 2028 keessa filannoo sadarkaa jalqabaa irratti hirmaatan keessaa hedduun isaanii gargaarsa waraanaa Israa'eliif kennamu mormu. Muraasni kun Israa'el Gaazaatti sanyi-fixiinsa raawwachaa jirti jedhanii kan amanan yoo ta'u, Israa'el irratti adabbii diinagdee fi tarkaanfiin seeraa akka fudhatamu deeggaru. Jijjiirramni kun deeggarsi Israa'eliif qabu keessumaa miseensota paartii Dimokraatawaa biratti akka xiqqaate kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Canada hits US with counter-tariffs on more than 700 products
english: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs on over 700 American products, valued at nearly $20 billion, following the collapse of trade negotiations with the United States. These measures, which take effect on September 8, are designed to match the new US duties on Canadian goods dollar-for-dollar. To support local companies affected by this escalating trade conflict, the Canadian government has also introduced a financial aid package worth $5.4 billion.
amharic: ካናዳ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የነበራት የንግድ ድርድር በመቋረጡ ምክንያት ከ700 በላይ በሆኑ የአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ የበቀል ቀረጥ መጣሏን አስታውቃለች። ወደ 20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት ዋጋ ያላቸው እነዚህ ምርቶች የሚታቀፉበት አዲሱ ቀረጥ መስከረም 28 ቀን ተግባራዊ ይሆናል። የካናዳ መንግስት በአሜሪካ የንግድ ጫና ምክንያት ጉዳት ለሚደርስባቸው አነስተኛ እና መካከለኛ ንግዶች የሚውል የ5.4 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የገንዘብ ድጋፍም አዘጋጅቷል።
oromo: Kanaadaan mariin daldalaa Ameerikaa waliin taasistee fashaluun ishee hordofee, oomishaalee Ameerikaa 700 ol ta'an irratti gatii dabalataa (tariffs) keessuuf murteessiteetti. Tariiifini kun kan inni hojii irra oolu Fulbaana 28 yoo ta'u, gatiin oomishaalee kanaas tilmaamaan dolaara biiliyoona 20 gaha. Mootummaan Kanaadaa daldala kana keessatti miidhaa dhaqqabuu danda'u irraa dhaabbilee xixiqqoo fi giddugaleessaaf deeggarsa maallaqaa biiliyoona 5.4 ta'u kan ramade yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii Ameerikaa dura dhaabbachuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: US judge denies Ghislaine Maxwell’s ‘frivolous’ bid to throw out conviction
english: A federal judge has dismissed Ghislaine Maxwell’s attempt to overturn her sex trafficking convictions, describing her arguments as groundless and rambling. Maxwell had claimed that recently released documents related to Jeffrey Epstein would prove her innocence, but the judge ruled that these files actually support the original verdict against her. Consequently, Maxwell must continue serving her 20-year prison sentence for her role in helping Epstein abuse underage girls.
amharic: አንድ የፌደራል ዳኛ ጊስሊን ማክስዌል በወሲባዊ ንግድ ወንጀል የተላለፈባትን የጥፋተኝነት ውሳኔ ለመሻር ያቀረበችውን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገውታል። ዳኛው ማክስዌል የቀረበው አቤቱታ ምንም ዓይነት ተጨባጭ መረጃ የሌለውና ግራ የሚያጋባ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ከጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን ጋር በተያያዘ የተለቀቁ አዳዲስ ፋይሎች ጥፋተኛ እንዳልሆነች እንደሚያሳዩ ብትከራከርም፣ ዳኛው ግን ፋይሎቹ በተቃራኒው የቀድሞውን የጥፋተኝነት ውሳኔ የሚያጠናክሩ መሆናቸውን አስረድተዋል። ስለዚህም ማክስዌል በታዳጊዎች ላይ ለፈጸመችው ወንጀል የተወሰነባትን የ20 ዓመት እስራት መቀጠል አለባት።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa tokko, Ghislaine Maxwell yakka gudeeddii fi daldala saalaarratti qabamtee murtaa'eef irratti dhiyeessite dhaggeeffachuu diduun gatuu isaa ibseera. Maxwell ragaan dhiyeessite waa'ee Jeffrey Epstein kanneen dhiyeenya gadhiifaman qulqulluu ishee akka ta'e kan agarsiisan ta'uu ibsuuf yaaltus, abbaan seerichaa garuu ragaan kun isa dura murtaa'eef sun sirrii ta'uu kan mirkaneessu ta'uu ibseera. Kanaafuu, Maxwell yakka ijoollee irratti raawwatteen adabbii hidhaa waggaa 20 itti murtaa'e xumuruun ishee dirqama ta'a.

title: OIC condemns Israeli raid of Unrwa headquarters
english: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation has formally denounced the Israeli military's recent raid on the UNRWA headquarters located near Jerusalem. The Secretary-General described this action as a dangerous escalation that threatens the vital aid, health, and educational services the agency provides to Palestinian refugees. He is now urging the global community to take immediate action to safeguard the organization and its operations.
amharic: የእስላማዊ ትብብር ድርጅት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በቁዱስ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ኤጀንሲ (UNRWA) ዋና መስሪያ ቤት ላይ ያደረሱትን ጥቃት አውግዟል። የድርጅቱ ዋና ፀሐፊ ድርጊቱ ለፍልስጤም ስደተኞች አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የጤና፣ የትምህርት እና የእርዳታ አገልግሎቶችን አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በመሆኑም ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ የኤጀንሲውን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ በአስቸኳይ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Walta'iinsa Islaamummaa (OIC) waraanni Israa'eel waajjira guddaa dhaabbata gargaarsa baqattoota Falasxiin (UNRWA) kan magaalaa Quddus biratti argamu irratti raawwate balaaleffateera. Gulaalaan olaanaa dhaabbatichaa akka jedhetti, gochi kun tajaajila fayyaa, barnootaa fi gargaarsa namummaa baqattootaaf kennamu kan miidhuu fi rakkoo kana daran kan hammeessu dha. Kanaafuu, hawaasni addunyaa dhaabbaticha fi hojii isaa eeguuf tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa akka fudhatu gaafateera.

title: Turkey won’t abandon Syria or let Israel draw ‘red lines’, Erdogan says
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has vowed that Turkey will continue to support its regional allies and will not allow outside powers to dictate its foreign policy after Israel bombed a Syrian airbase. While Israel claimed the strike was to prevent Turkey from deploying air defenses near its border, Ankara maintains that its presence in Syria is only for infrastructure repairs. Erdogan rejected Israel's claims as politically motivated, asserting that Turkey remains committed to its neighbors regardless of foreign opposition.
amharic: የቱርኩ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶሃን እስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሷን ተከትሎ፣ ቱርክ ለክልሉ አጋሮቿ ድጋፍ ማድረጓን እንደማታቆምና የውጭ ኃይላት በፖሊሲዎቿ ላይ ጣልቃ እንዲገቡ እንደማትፈቅድ አስታውቀዋል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው ቱርክ በሶሪያ የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓቶችን እንዳትተክል ለመከላከል ነው ብትልም፣ ቱርክ ግን በቦታው የምትገኘው የመሰረተ ልማት ጥገና ለማድረግ ብቻ እንደሆነ ገልጻለች። ኤርዶሃን የእስራኤልን ድርጊት የፖለቲካ ፍላጎት ያነገበ ነው በማለት በመተቸት፣ ቱርክ የራሷን የውጭ ግንኙነት መንገድ እንደምትከተል አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin biyya Turkii Rejeb Xayyib Erdogaan, Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaa irratti haleellaa erga raawwattee booda, Turkiin michoota ishee naannichaa gargaaruu akka itti fuftuufi dhiibbaa alaa kamiyyuu akka hin fudhanne ibsaniiru. Israa'el haleellaa kana kan raawwatte Turkiin daangaa ishee biratti sirna ittisa xiyyaaraa akka hin dhaabneef akka ta'e dubbattuus, Turkiin garuu hojiin ishee buufata sana suphuu qofa akka ta'e himti. Erdogaan gocha Israa'el kun fayyadama siyaasaa qofa kan qabuufi Turkiin imaammata ishee bilisummaan murteessuuf mirga akka qabdu jabeessanii dubbataniiru.

title: Ending the war and preserving unity is our priority, says Iranian president
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has emphasized that his administration's main focus is to end ongoing conflicts and maintain national unity. He clarified that recent agreements with the U.S. were based on strategic reasoning rather than surrender. Furthermore, he noted that Iran's adversaries are targeting the country through economic sanctions and social instability after failing to achieve their goals through military means.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ መዘሽኪያን የአገራቸው ዋና ትኩረት ጦርነትን ማቆም እና ብሄራዊ አንድነትን መጠበቅ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ከአሜሪካ ጋር የተፈረሙ ስምምነቶች መገዛትን ሳይሆን በሎጂክ እና በእውቀት ላይ የተመሰረቱ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም የኢራን ጠላቶች በወታደራዊ መንገድ ማሸነፍ ስላልቻሉ፣ አገሪቱን ለማዳከም በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና በማህበራዊ ችግሮች ላይ ማተኮራቸውን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan akka jedhanitti, xiyyeffannoon mootummaa isaanii inni guddaan waraana dhaabuu fi tokkummaa biyyaa eeggachuu dha. Walii-galtee Ameerikaa waliin taasisan sana kan mallatteessan harka kennachuu irraa utuu hin taane, karooraa fi hubannoo irraa maddee akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, diinonni Iraan karaa waraanaan biyyattii injifachuu waan hin dandeenyeef, qabeenyaa fi diinagdee irratti dhiibbaa gochuun ummata gidduutti rakkoo uumuuf yaalaa akka jiran dubbataniiru.

title: Carlos Baleba joins Manchester United in transfer from Brighton
english: Manchester United has officially signed Cameroonian midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton on a deal running until 2031. The transfer is reportedly worth approximately 70 million pounds, marking a significant investment to strengthen the team's midfield. Baleba joins other new arrivals to help fill the void left by Casemiro's departure to Inter Miami.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ ካሜሮናዊውን አማካይ ካርሎስ ባሌባን ከብራይተን በይፋ ማስፈረሙን አስታውቋል። ስምምነቱ እስከ 2031 ዓ.ም ድረስ የሚቆይ ሲሆን፣ የዝውውር ዋጋውም ወደ 70 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ እንደሚጠጋ ይገመታል። ይህ ዝውውር ካሴሚሮ ወደ ኢንተር ማያሚ ካመራ በኋላ ክፍት የነበረውን የአማካይ ክፍል ቦታ ለመሸፈን የተደረገ ዋና ጥረት ነው።
oromo: Maanchestar Yuunaayited taphataa giddu galeessa biyya Kaameruun Kaarloos Baaleebaa kilabii Biraayiten irraa gara isaanii akka fidan ifa godhaniiru. Walii galteen kun hanga bara 2031 tti kan turu yoo ta'u, gatiin jijjiirraa isaas paawundii miiliyoona 70 akka ta'e himameera. Guddichi kun Kaaseemiroo gara Inter Miyaamitti deemuu isaatiin giddu galeessa irratti bakka duwwaa hafe guutuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Sanctions or missiles? Why Gulf may not relish Trump’s new Iran approach
english: The United States has launched a new campaign of severe economic sanctions against Iran, aiming to force the country into a peace agreement. While Gulf nations generally prefer economic pressure over military conflict, they fear that these sanctions might provoke Iran into attacking regional energy infrastructure or blocking the vital Strait of Hormuz. Consequently, these countries are caught in a difficult position where their security partnership with Washington also makes them direct targets for Iranian retaliation.
amharic: አሜሪካ ኢራንን ወደ ሰላም ስምምነት ለማምጣት በማለም በአገሪቱ ላይ አዳዲስ እና ጠንካራ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን ጥላለች። የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት ወታደራዊ ግጭትን ከመፍራት ይልቅ የኢኮኖሚ ግፊትን ቢመርጡም፣ እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች ኢራን በክልሉ የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት እንድትሰነዝር ወይም የሆርሙዝን የባህር በር እንድትዘጋ ሊገፋፏት እንደሚችሉ ይሰጋሉ። በዚህም ምክንያት እነዚህ አገራት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸው የፀጥታ ግንኙነት ለኢራን የበቀል እርምጃ ተጋላጭ እንዲሆኑ እያደረጋቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Ameerikaan biyya Iraan gara waliigaltee nagaatti fiduuf jechuun, tarkaanfiwwan diinagdee cimaa ta'an irratti fudhatteetti. Biyyoonni Gulfi waraana caalaa dhiibbaa diinagdee filataniyyuu, dhiibbaan kun Iraan bu'uuraalee misoomaa naannichaa irratti akka duultu ykn daandii galaana Hormuz akka cufu gochuu danda'a jedhanii sodaatu. Kanaafuu, biyyoonni kunneen hariiroo nageenyaa Ameerikaa wajjin qaban irraa kan ka'e, tarkaanfii deebii Iraan irraa dhufuuf karaa saaxilamoo ta'aniiru.

title: UN chief 'greatly alarmed' as Israeli forces raid Unwra
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has expressed serious concern after Israeli troops raided a UN-run vocational training center in East Jerusalem. Guterres emphasized that UN facilities are protected and immune from interference, noting that this action disrupts essential education for Palestinian youth. He condemned the intrusion as a violation of the sanctity and legal status of United Nations property.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በሚገኝ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሙያ ማሰልጠኛ ማዕከል ላይ ወረራ መፈጸማቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ጉቴሬዝ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ተቋማት የተጠበቁ እና ከማንኛውም ጣልቃ ገብነት ነጻ መሆናቸውን በማስታወስ፣ ድርጊቱ ለፍልስጤም ወጣቶች የሚሰጠውን አስፈላጊ ትምህርት እንደሚያስተጓጉል አስረድተዋል። ይህንን ድርጊት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትን ንብረት መብት እንደጣሰ በመቁጠርም አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Garee ergamtoota tokkummaa mootummootaa (UN) Antonio Guterres, humnoonni Israa'el bakka leenjii hoji-harkaa kan UN magaalaa Yerusaalem bahaatti argamu cabsanii seenuusaaniitti gaddi guddaan itti dhaga'ameera. Guterres bakkeewwan UN humnaan seenuun seeraan alaa fi kan dhowwamu ta'uu eeruun, gochi kun dargaggoota Falasxiin barnoota isaanii akka hin arganne taasisuu isaa ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, gochi kun mirgaa fi nageenya qabeenya dhaabbaticha irratti cabsuu ta'uu isaa himaniiru.

title: Netanyahu says Unrwa raid carried out in accordance with law, Ben Gvir says UN agency 'in our hands'
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended the recent military raid on a UNRWA facility in the West Bank, claiming it followed legal directives to stop organizations involved in terrorism. Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir joined the operation and celebrated the takeover of the site on social media. The Israeli government maintains that it will continue to take action against the UN agency due to allegations that its staff were linked to the October 7 attacks.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ኤጀንሲ (UNRWA) ላይ የተፈጸመውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ በህግ መሰረት እንደሆነ ገለጹ። እስራኤል ከጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በሚል የኤጀንሲውን ስራ ለመገደብ ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል። የሀገሪቱ የብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪርም በቦታው በመገኘት ወታደራዊ እርምጃውን በአዎንታዊ መልኩ አድንቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun tarkaanfiin waraanni isaanii dhaabbata UNRWA irratti bulchiinsa Wiyyeest Baankitti fudhate seera qabeessa ta'uu ibsanii jiru. Mootummaan Israa'el hojjettoonni dhaabbatichaa weerara Onkoloolessa 7 irratti hirmaataniiru jechuun, dhaabbatichi biyya isaanii keessatti akka hin hojjenne gochuuf murteessaniiru. Ministeerri Nageenya Biyyooolessaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gviir tarkaanfichaan booda dhaabbaticha to'annoo isaanii jala galchuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Three killed in Israeli bombing near Unrwa school in Jabalia camp
english: At least three Palestinians died and several others sustained injuries following an Israeli drone strike. The attack occurred near a school operated by the UN agency for Palestinian refugees in the Jabalia camp. The school was serving as a shelter for people who had been displaced by the ongoing conflict in northern Gaza.
amharic: በሰሜን ጋዛ በሚገኘው የጃባሊያ መጠለያ ካምፕ እስራኤል በፈጸመችው የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ኤጀንሲ (UNRWA) ትምህርት ቤት አቅራቢያ ነው። ይህ ትምህርት ቤት ከቤታቸው ለተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች መጠለያ ሆኖ እያገለገለ ነበር።
oromo: Kaaba Gaazaatti magaala Jabaliyaa keessatti xiyyaaraan daandii irra balali’uun (drone) haleellaa gaggeesseen namoonni Falasxiin sadii du’aniiru, kanneen biroos miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame mana barumsaa dhaabbata gargaarsa godaantota Falasxiin kan UN (UNRWA) biratti. Mana barumsichaa kana keessa namoonni sababa waraanaan buqqa’an godaantota ta’anii qubatanii turan.

title: Israeli air strikes target towns in southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces have conducted air strikes and heavy artillery shelling across several locations in southern Lebanon, leading to widespread fires that emergency teams are finding difficult to manage. According to local officials, these ongoing hostilities since early March have resulted in over 4,300 deaths and more than 12,000 injuries. The situation remains critical as regional instability continues to impact civilian areas.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች የአየር ድብደባ እና የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ ከፍተዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ሰፊ የእሳት አደጋ ያስከተለ ሲሆን የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር እየተቸገሩ ይገኛሉ። ባለሥልጣናት እንደገለጹት ከመጋቢት ወር ጀምሮ በተካሄዱት ጥቃቶች ከ4,300 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸውን እና ከ12,000 በላይ ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el kibba Libaanoos keessatti xiyyaaraanis ta'ee meeshaa gurguddaan haleellaa geggeessuun isaanii gabaafameera. Haleellaa kana hordofee iddoowwan garaagaraatti ibiddi ka'uun, gargaartoonni ariifachiisoon ibidda kana dhaamsuuf rakkoo keessa jiru. Ministirri fayyaa Libaanoos akka ibsetti, haleellaa ji'a Sadaasaa irraa jalqabee geggeeffameen lubbuun namoota 4,350 ol darbuu fi namoonni 12,310 ol ta'an miidhamuu isaanii beeksiseera.

title: Oman and Iran propose temporary shipping lane through Strait of Hormuz
english: Oman and Iran have announced a collaborative plan to ensure safer travel for ships moving through the Strait of Hormuz. The initiative involves creating a temporary shared maritime route and conducting a joint effort to remove underwater mines from the area. Both nations will continue holding technical discussions to reach a long-term resolution for the waterway.
amharic: ኦማን እና ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በኩል የሚደረገውን መርከቦች ጉዞ ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ የሚያስችል የጋራ ዕቅድ ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ስምምነት ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ መተላለፊያ መንገድ መፍጠርን እና በውሃው ውስጥ ያሉ ፈንጂዎችን በጋራ የማጽዳት ስራን ያካትታል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ለችግሩ ዘላቂ መፍትሄ ለማግኘት የቴክኒክ ንግግሮቻቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Oman fi Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz keessa markabni nagaan akka darban gochuuf karoorfatan. Karoorri kun daandii yerooif markabni itti darban uumuu fi bishaanicha keessatti kan argaman miinii ykn bomiiwwan lafa jalaatti dhokatan qulqulleessuu of keessatti qabata. Biyyoonni lamaan kun rakkoo kanaaf furmaata waaraa argachuuf marii tekinikaa itti fufuuf walii galaniiru.

title: Photos: Rohingya refugees rally nine years after Myanmar exodus
english: Thousands of Rohingya refugees living in crowded Bangladeshi camps recently held large protests to mark nine years since fleeing a violent military crackdown in Myanmar. The demonstrators are calling on the international community to help ensure their safety so they can finally return home to Rakhine state. Although repatriation discussions have occurred, they remain stalled because the refugees fear for their safety and refuse to go back under current conditions.
amharic: በባንግላዴሽ በሚገኙ መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች የሚኖሩ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች ከምያንማር በወታደራዊ ጥቃት ከተፈናቀሉ ዘጠኝ ዓመታት መሙላቱን አስመልክቶ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ስደተኞቹ ወደ ቀያቸው ራካይን ግዛት በሰላም ለመመለስ የሚያስችል ዋስትና እንዲሰጣቸው ዓለም አቀፉን ማህበረሰብ ጠይቀዋል። እስካሁን የተደረጉ ወደ ሀገር የመመለስ ጥረቶች ስደተኞቹ በምያንማር ውስጥ ያለው ሁኔታ አሁንም አደገኛ ነው በሚል ስጋት በመቀበላቸው ሳይሳኩ ቀርተዋል።
oromo: Godina Baangilaadeshitti buufata baqattootaa keessa kan jiraatan Roohiingaa kumaatama lakkaa'aman, waraana Miyaanmaar irraa waggaa sagal dura ari'amuu isaanii yaadachuun hiriira guddaa geggeessaniiru. Baqattoonni kunneen gara biyyatti, naannoo Raakaayinitti nageenyaan deebi'uuf akka isaan gargaaran hawaasa idil-addunyaa gaafataniiru. Yaaliin gara biyyatti deebisuuf godhame hanga ammaatti kan hin milkoofne, baqattoonni nageenya isaanii sodaatanii fi haalli ammaa biyyattii keessa jiru tasgabba'aa waan hin taaneef dha.

title: Students clash with police in India in a new protest over exam leaks
english: Hundreds of students in India's Bihar state engaged in violent confrontations with police during a protest on Tuesday. The demonstrators were expressing their anger over suspected cheating and leaked documents associated with a state administrative officer recruitment exam. The test in question was originally administered over a year ago, leading to widespread frustration among candidates.
amharic: በህንድ ቢሃር ግዛት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎች ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት ውስጥ ገብተዋል። ተማሪዎቹ የተቃውሞ ሰልፉን ያካሄዱት ለአስተዳደር መኮንንነት ምልመላ ተብሎ የተዘጋጀው ፈተና መሰረዙን እና የፈተና ወረቀቶች መውጣቱን በመቃወም ነው። ይህ ባለፈው ዓመት ተሰጥቶ የነበረው ፈተና አሁንም ድረስ በውዝግብ ውስጥ መቆየቱ ተማሪዎቹን አስቆጥቷል።
oromo: Naannoo biyya Hindi kan ta'e Bihaar keessatti, barattoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman poolisoota wajjin walitti bu'aniiru. Barattoonni kun kan mormaa jiran qormaata ramaddii hojjettoota mootummaa wajjin walqabatee qormaatichi xiqqaachuu fi seeraan alaa ta'uu isaatiin walqabata. Qormaatni kun waggaa tokko dura kan kenname yoo ta'u, barattoonni rakkoo mudate kana mormuun karaatti ba'aniiru.

title: CIA chief in Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
english: The director of the CIA has made an unannounced visit to Moscow, arriving on a US military aircraft. While both the American and Russian governments have kept the details of the visit private, such high-level meetings are unusual given the ongoing tensions between the two nations. This trip marks a significant diplomatic moment, as it is one of the first visits by a top US official to Russia during President Trump's second term.
amharic: የሲአይኤ (CIA) ዳይሬክተር በድንገት ወደ ሞስኮ በዩኤስ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ጉብኝት አድርገዋል። የአሜሪካ እና የሩሲያ መንግስታት ስለ ጉብኝቱ ዝርዝር መረጃ ባይሰጡም፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ባለው የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ምክንያት እንዲህ ያሉ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያላቸው ስብሰባዎች ያልተለመዱ ናቸው። ይህ ጉብኝት በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ሁለተኛ የስልጣን ዘመን በከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣን ወደ ሩሲያ ከተደረጉ የመጀመሪያዎቹ ጉዞዎች አንዱ በመሆኑ ትልቅ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ትኩረት አግኝቷል።
oromo: Hoogganaan garee iccitii Amerikaa (CIA) xiyyara waraanaan gara Moskooti imala tasaa ta'e godhaniiru. Mootummoonni Amerikaas ta'e Raashiyaa waa'ee imala kanaa ilaalchisee ibsa kennuu baatanis, hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii waan jabaateef walgahii sadarkaa olaanaatti gaggeeffamuun kun kan barame miti. Imalli kun yeroo pirezidaant Traamp erga aangoo qabatanii booda hoogganaa olaanaa Amerikaa irraa gara Raashiyaatti imalame keessaa tokko waan ta'eef, iddoo guddaa qaba.

title: Nevada wildfire contained to 27 percent as thousands still displaced
english: A major wildfire near Reno, Nevada, has reached 27 percent containment after destroying dozens of homes and forcing thousands of people to evacuate. Although the fire has stopped spreading, seven people have been injured and officials expect the damage toll to increase as they inspect the area. This is the third fire in the region in two weeks, and schools remain closed as authorities continue to monitor for shifting winds.
amharic: በኔቫዳ ሬኖ አቅራቢያ የተነሳው መጠነ ሰፊ የእሳት ቃጠሎ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶችን ካወደመ እና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ካፈናቀለ በኋላ በ27 በመቶ ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የእሳቱ መስፋፋት የቆመ ቢሆንም፣ ሰባት ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ሲመረምሩ የደረሰው ጉዳት ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ስጋት አድሮባቸዋል። በሁለት ሳምንት ውስጥ በክልሉ የተከሰተ ሶስተኛው የእሳት አደጋ ይህ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት የአየር ሁኔታን እየተከታተሉ በመሆኑ ትምህርት ቤቶች ዝግ ሆነው ይቆያሉ።
oromo: Ibidda cimaa magaalaa Reno, Nevada biratti ka'een erga manni hedduun barbada'ee fi namoonni kumaatamaan buqqa'anii booda, amma %27 to'annoo jala galeera. ibidichi babalachuu dhaabatus, namoota torba irratti miidhaan ga'eera; akkasumas bakkeewwan gubatan qorachaa waan jiraniif miidhaan inni geesise dabaluu mala jedhamee amanama. Ibidni kun torban lama keessatti naannichatti yeroo sadaffaaf ka'uudha; haala qilleensaa fi qilleensa bubbee hordofuuf jecha mana barumsaatu cufamee jira.

title: Chinese robot Tiangong clocks sub-9-second 100 metres in Beijing
english: A Chinese humanoid robot named Tiangong recently completed a 100-meter sprint in 8.86 seconds during the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. This performance is notably faster than the long-standing human world record held by Usain Bolt. The event, which features thousands of robots competing in various activities, highlights the rapid technological advancements in robotics.
amharic: ቲያንጎንግ የተሰኘ የቻይና የሰው ቅርጽ ያለው ሮቦት በቤጂንግ በተካሄደው የአለም የሮቦቶች ውድድር የ100 ሜትር ሩጫን በ8.86 ሰከንድ በማጠናቀቅ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል። ይህ ውጤት ዩሴን ቦልት ካስመዘገበው የሰው ልጅ የአለም ክብረ ወሰን በአጅጉ ፈጣን ነው። በቤጂንግ እየተካሄደ ያለው ይህ ውድድር በሮቦቲክስ ቴክኖሎጂ የታየውን አስደናቂ እድገት ያሳያል።
oromo: Roobotiin bifa namaa qabu Tiangong jedhamu tokko, Beijingitti dorgommii roobotaa adunyaa irratti meetira 100 sekondii 8.86 keessatti xumuruun riikardii haaraa galmeesseera. Gatiin kun riikardii atileetii Yuseen Boolt qabu kan caaluudha. Dorgommiin Beijingitti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun, teeknooloojii roobotaa guddina guddaa agarsiisaa jira.

title: Infantino’s presidency under threat: FIFA elections, challengers, dates
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino is facing significant challenges to his leadership as his support among national football federations declines. Critics are particularly concerned about his close ties to US political figures and his controversial proposal to privatize World Cup profits. With elections approaching in six months, his decade-long tenure is under threat due to growing international backlash.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በአገር አቀፍ የእግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽኖች ዘንድ ያላቸው ድጋፍ እየቀነሰ በመምጣቱ የአመራር ሥልጣናቸው አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል። ተቺዎች በተለይም ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የፖለቲካ ሰዎች ጋር ያላቸው የቅርብ ግንኙነት እና የዓለም ዋንጫ ትርፍን ወደ ግል ለማዞር ያቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። በስድስት ወራት ውስጥ ምርጫው የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ በአሥር ዓመታት ውስጥ ባካበቱት ተጽዕኖ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እየገጠማቸው ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin FIFA Jaannii Infantinoo deeggarsa federeshiniiwwan kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa biratti dhabuun hoggansi isaa balaa keessa galeera. Qeeqonni keessattuu hariiroo inni angawoota siyaasaa Yunaayitid Isteetsii wajjin qabu fi karoora inni bu'aa Waldaa Kubbaa Miilaa Addunyaa (World Cup) gara dhuunfaatti jijjiiruuf qabu irratti komii guddaa qabu. Ji'oota jahan dhufan keessatti filannoon waan jiruuf, qeeqni idil-addunyaa irratti xiyyeeffate kun waggaa kudhan booda aangoo isaa jalaa raasaa jira.

title: Nine years of Rohingya refugee crisis
english: It has been nine years since a violent military crackdown in Myanmar forced the Rohingya people to flee their homes for safety. Many sought refuge in Bangladesh, where over 1.2 million individuals continue to reside in camps today. The United Nations has previously described the military actions against this community as having genocidal intent.
amharic: የሮሂንጋ ሕዝብ ከማያንማር ወደ ባንግላዴሽ ከተሰደደ ዘጠኝ ዓመታት ተቆጥረዋል። በወቅቱ በወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተፈናቀሉት ከ1.2 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች አሁንም በስደተኛ ካምፖች ውስጥ በችግር ላይ ይገኛሉ። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በሮሂንጋዎች ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት ዘር የማጥፋት ዓላማ የነበረው መሆኑን አስታውቆ ነበር።
oromo: Sabni Roohingiyaa lola fi dararaa biyya Maaniyaamar irraa baqatee gara Baangilaadesh erga seenee waggaan sagal darbeera. Namoonni miiliyoona 1.2 ol ta'an amma iyyuu baqattummaan buufataalee garaagaraa keessa jiraachaa jiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii tarkaanfiin waraanni biyyattii isaan irratti fudhate kaayyoo sanyii duguuggaa kan qabu ture jechuun gabaaseera.

title: Gaza marks one year since Mariam Dagga was killed in Israeli strike
english: Mourners in Khan Younis recently gathered to commemorate the first anniversary of an Israeli airstrike that killed 22 people at a Gaza hospital. Among those who lost their lives in the attack were journalist Mariam Dagga and several emergency responders. Despite the significant loss of life, no officials have faced accountability for this incident.
amharic: በካን ዩኒስ የሚገኙ የሟች ቤተሰቦች እና ወዳጆች በጋዛ ሆስፒታል ላይ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት የጋዜጠኛ ማርያም ዳጋን ጨምሮ 22 ሰዎች ከተገደሉ አንድ ዓመት መሙላቱን አስታውሰዋል። በጥቃቱ ወቅት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞችም ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። እስካሁን ድረስ ለዚህ ድርጊት ተጠያቂ የሆነ አካል አለመኖሩም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Namoonni gaddan Khan Yunisitti walga’uun, waraana Israa’el hospitaala Gaazaatti gaggeesseen gaazexeessituu Maariyaam Daaggaa dabalatee namoonni 22 erga ajjeefamanii waggaa tokko guutuu isaa yaadataniiru. Ajjeechaa kanaan gargaartonnii fi ogeessonni fayyaa lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Ajjeechaa kanaaf hanga ammaatti qaamni itti gaafatamummaa fudhate hin jiru.

title: Child injured by Israeli forces' gunfire in Qalandia refugee camp
english: A Palestinian child was shot and injured in the shoulder by Israeli soldiers during an operation in the Qalandia refugee camp near Jerusalem. This event occurred as tensions rise in the area due to Israeli forces taking control of a local vocational training center. The situation follows an escalation in military presence and activities within the camp.
amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው በቃላንዲያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ውስጥ እስራኤላዊያን ወታደሮች በከፈቱት ተኩስ አንድ የፍልስጤም ህጻን ትከሻው ላይ ቆስሏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው እስራኤላዊያን ወታደሮች በካምፑ ውስጥ የሚገኝ የሙያ ማሰልጠኛ ማዕከልን በኃይል መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ በተፈጠረው ግጭት ነው። በካምፑ ውስጥ ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ መጨመር በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Buufata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa kan Yerusaalemitti argamu keessatti, waraanni Israa'el dhukaasa bananiin mucaan tokko kan gubbee irraa miidhamee jira. Miidhaan kun kan uumame yeroo waraanni Israa'el buufata sana keessatti iddoo leenjii hojii harka qaban tokko humnaan to'annaa isaanii jala galchanidha. Haalli kun walitti bu'iinsa fi lola naannichatti dabalaa deemu keessatti kan uumame dha.

title: War on Iran: Left-wing luminaries behind Guardian letter have lost the plot
english: A group of prominent activists recently published a letter in The Guardian that equates the Iranian government's human rights abuses with the aggressive military actions taken against Iran by Israel and the US. The author criticizes these intellectuals for adopting a 'both-sides' perspective, arguing that their stance ignores the reality of the destructive aerial bombings and the anti-colonial sentiment rising within Iran. Ultimately, the piece suggests that this call for intervention fails to support actual Iranian political prisoners who have publicly condemned the foreign military attacks.
amharic: የአንድ ቡድን ታዋቂ አክቲቪስቶች በጋርዲያን ጋዜጣ ላይ ባወጡት ደብዳቤ የኢራን መንግሥት በሰብአዊ መብት ላይ የሚፈጽመውን ጥሰት በእስራኤል እና በአሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ እየተወሰዱ ካሉ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ጋር አነጻጽረዋል። የጽሁፉ ደራሲ እነዚህ ምሁራን ሁለቱንም ወገን ተጠያቂ የሚያደርግ አቋም በመውሰዳቸው ይተቸዋል፤ ይህ አካሄድ በኢራን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የቦምብ ጥቃት እና በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ እየተቀጣጠለ ያለውን ፀረ-ቅኝ ግዛት ስሜት ችላ የሚል ነው ይላል። በመጨረሻም፣ ይህ የጣልቃ ገብነት ጥሪ በውጭ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ላይ በይፋ የተቃውሞ ድምጻቸውን ላሰሙ የኢራን ፖለቲካ እስረኞች ትክክለኛ ድጋፍ እንደማይሰጥ ይከራከራል።
oromo: Gareen aktivistoota beekamoo ta'an tokko barreeffama 'The Guardian' irratti baasaniin, mootummaan Iran mirga namoomaa darbuu isaa fi gocha waraanaa Israa'el fi Ameerikaan Iran irratti raawwachaa jiran wal-qixxeessanii ilaalu. Barreessaan kun yaada kana ni balaaleffata; kunis tarkaanfiiwwan xiyyaaraan darbaa jiruufi miira qabsoo gita-bittaa mormuu Iran keessatti mul'achaa jiru kan dagatanii dha. Walumaagalatti, yaanni gargaarsa biyya alaa gaafatu kun, miidhaa waraanaa kana ofii isaanii kan morman hidhamtoota siyaasaa Iran irratti xiyyeeffannoo akka hin kennine ibsa.

title: Israeli forces to remain in Syria-Lebanon border area, says defence minister
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz announced that military forces will maintain a presence in the Mount Hermon region near the Syrian-Lebanese border. He stated that this strategic position is necessary to monitor threats from Damascus and Hezbollah while protecting local communities in the Golan Heights and Galilee. The minister emphasized that this ongoing occupation serves as a direct message to the Syrian leadership regarding Israel's commitment to border security.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በሶሪያና በሊባኖስ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሄርሞን ተራራ አካባቢ እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን እንደምታቆይ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ስልታዊ ቦታ በደማስቆና በሂዝቦላህ ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ስጋቶችን ለመከታተል እንዲሁም በጎላን ኮረብታና በገሊላ የሚገኙ የሀገሪቱን ማህበረሰቦች ለመጠበቅ ወሳኝ መሆኑን ሚኒስትሩ ገልጸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ እስራኤል ለድንበር ደህንነቷ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት ለሶሪያ መንግስት የሚያሳይ መልእክት እንደሆነም ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, loltoonni Israa'el naannoo gaara Hermoon kan daangaa Sooriyaa fi Libaanoos irratti argamu gadhiisanii akka hin baane beeksisaniiru. Bakki kun dirree waraanaaf mijataa waan ta'eef, iddoo kanatti turuun garaa fi humnoota Hizbullaah irraa balaa dhufu hordofuuf akkasumas naannoo Golan fi Galilii eeguuf akka gargaaru ibsaniiru. Ministeerichi tarkaanfiin kun Israa'el nageenya daangaa ishee eeggachuuf kutannoo qabdu mootummaa Sooriyaaf ergaa kan dabarsu ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
english: Two individuals in Pennsylvania have passed away from measles, highlighting a concerning rise in cases across the United States. Health officials noted that the vaccination rate in the affected area is too low to prevent community spread. Experts emphasize that the MMR vaccine remains the most effective way to protect against this dangerous and increasingly common illness.
amharic: በፔንሲልቬንያ በኩፍኝ በሽታ የተያዙ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ይህም በአሜሪካ የኩፍኝ በሽታ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተስፋፋ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። የጤና ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በተጎዳው አካባቢ ያለው የክትባት ሽፋን በሽታውን ለመከላከል የሚያስችል ደረጃ ላይ አይደለም። የጤና ባለሙያዎች ኩፍኝን ለመከላከል የኤም.ኤም.አር (MMR) ክትባት መውሰድ እጅግ በጣም አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ያስታውሳሉ።
oromo: Namootni lama kutaa Pensilveeniyaa keessatti dhukkuba fincaan (measles) du'aniiru, kunis Ameerikaa keessatti tatamsa'inni dhukkubichaa dabalaa dhufuu isaa agarsiisa. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa akka ibsanitti, naannoo kanatti kanneen talaallii fudhatan xiqqaa waan ta'eef, dhukkubichi salphaatti babal'achuu danda'eera. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa dhukkuba cimaa kana ittisuuf talaallii MMR fudhachuun furmaata guddaa akka ta'e gorsu.

title: One year since Gaza journalist killed by Israel
english: It has been one year since AP journalist Mariam Dagga lost her life during an Israeli military strike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital. Her family continues to seek accountability and justice for her death. This tragedy highlights the ongoing dangers faced by media professionals working in the conflict zone.
amharic: የኤ.ፒ. የዜና ወኪል ጋዜጠኛ ማሪያም ዳጋ በጋዛ ናሰር ሆስፒታል ላይ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት ከተገደለች አንድ ዓመት ሆኗታል። የሟች ቤተሰቦች ለደረሰባቸው ጉዳት ፍትህ እንዲሰጣቸው አሁንም በመጠባበቅ ላይ ናቸው። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በግጭት ቀጠና ውስጥ የሚሰሩ ጋዜጠኞች ለከፍተኛ አደጋ የተጋለጡ መሆናቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun dhaabbata oduu AP, Mariyam Daaggaa, hospitaala Naasir kan Gaazaa keessatti miidhaa qaqqabeen du’uu ishee waggaa tokko guuteera. Maatiin ishee du’a ishee ilaalchisee ammayyuu haqni akka bahuuf gaafachaa jiru. Balaan kun gaazexeessitoota naannoo waraanaa keessa hojjetan balaa hamaa keessa akka jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: No, the Democratic Party is not shifting on Israel
english: Despite recent primary victories by progressive candidates critical of Israel, the Democratic Party establishment remains fundamentally supportive of the Israeli government. While public polling shows a significant decline in sympathy for Israel among Democratic voters, party leadership is merely adjusting its rhetoric to manage political pressure. These shifts in language are strategic election-year maneuvers rather than a genuine change in long-standing institutional policy.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን እስራኤልን የሚቃወሙ ፕሮግረሲቭ እጩዎች በቅርቡ ምርጫዎችን ቢያሸንፉም፣ የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ አመራር አሁንም እስራኤልን በፅኑ መደገፉን ቀጥሏል። የፓርቲው መራጮች ለእስራኤል ያላቸው ድጋፍ ቢቀንስም፣ የአመራር ክፍሉ ይህንን የፖለቲካ ግፊት ለማርገብ ንግግራቸውን በመጠኑ እየቀያየሩ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ለውጦች ትክክለኛ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ሳይሆኑ፣ በምርጫ ወቅት የድምፅ ማግኛ ስልቶች ብቻ ናቸው።
oromo: Haa ta'u malee, kaadhimamtoonni jijjiirama barbaadan kanneen Israa'el morman injifannoo argachuu isaanii irra iyyuu, hoogganoonni paartii Dimokiraataas Israa'el deggeruu isaanii itti fufaniiru. Warri paartichaa Israa'el deggaruun isaanitti akka hir'ate yoo mul'ateyyuu, hoogganoonni paartichaa dhiibbaa siyaasaa jiru hir'isuuf jecha jechoota isaanii jijjiirachaa jiru. Jijjiiramoonni kun garaagarummaa imaammata dhugaa osoo hin taane, tarsiimoo sagalee argachuuf godhamuudha.

title: Root ‘hacked off’ by England cricket team after police handcuff Carse
english: England Test captain Joe Root has expressed his deep frustration after bowler Brydon Carse was dropped from the team for being handcuffed by police following a nightclub incident. This event is the latest in a series of alcohol-related controversies involving England players that have distracted from the team's performance on the field. Root criticized his teammates for repeatedly making foolish errors and emphasized the need to build a more professional team culture instead of relying on restrictive curfews.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ የቴስት ክሪኬት ቡድን ካፒቴን ጆ ሩት፣ የቡድኑ አባል ብራይደን ካርስ በምሽት ክበብ ግጭት ተጠርጥሮ በፖሊስ እጅ ከተያዘ በኋላ ከቡድኑ መታገዱ በእጅጉ እንዳሳዘነው ገልጿል። ይህ ክስተት ከቅርብ ጊዜ ወዲህ በእንግሊዝ ተጫዋቾች ላይ በተደጋጋሚ ሲፈጸሙ የነበሩ የአልኮል ነክ ችግሮች አካል ሲሆን፣ የቡድኑን ጥሩ አቋም ጥላሸት እየቀባው ይገኛል። ሩት ተጫዋቾቹ በተደጋጋሚ የሚፈጽሟቸውን ሞኝነት የተሞላባቸው ስህተቶች በመተቸት፣ ቡድኑ በውጫዊ መመሪያዎች ከመገደብ ይልቅ ኃላፊነት የሚሰማው ባህል እንዲገነባ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Kapiteenni garee kiriketiin Ingiliz Joo Ruut, taphataan Bowler Brydon Carse jedhamu halkan mana dhugaatii keessatti poolisiin qabamee erga hiikamee booda garee keessaa hir'ifamuun isaa baay'ee akka isa aarse ibseera. Kuni rakkoo dhugaatii fi amalaan walqabatee taphatoota Ingiliz irraa yeroo dhihoo as deddeebi'ee mul'achaa jiru keessaa isa tokko yoo ta'u, gama taphaan argamaa jiru irratti dhiibbaa gaarii hin taane uumaa jira. Ruut taphatootni isaa dogoggora gowwummaa irra deddeebi'anii raawwachuu isaanitti kan gadde yoo ta'u, gareen sun qajeelfama cimaan utuu hin taane, aadaa itti gaafatamummaa qabu ijaarachuu akka qaban dhaameera.

title: Trump floats renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America during Canada trade war
english: President Donald Trump has suggested renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America as tensions rise during a trade dispute with Canada. This proposal follows the U.S. government's decision to impose 50 percent tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods. Canadian officials have stated they will not engage with these comments and are preparing to implement their own retaliatory measures.

Beijing remains strongly opposed to these unilateral measures and has urged both nations to prioritize diplomatic negotiations over economic confrontation.

Although he was escorted by the military, the army stated that the destruction was unauthorized and took steps to stop the act.

This new zero-tolerance policy aims to ensure safe navigation through these important international waters.

Beijing firmly rejects these unilateral penalties and has the legal capacity to strike back, particularly by restricting critical mineral exports essential to American industries.

title: Israeli lawmaker smashes Palestinian memorial in occupied West Bank
